senses.english: used to refer to something already mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: I found a wallet outside the library and handed the wallet to a member of staff.
senses.exampleChinese: 我在图书馆外发现一个钱包，把它交给了一名工作人员。

senses.chinese: 指独一无二或双方知道的人事物
senses.english: identifies someone or something known or unique
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited beside the main entrance until the guide returned with enough tickets for our whole group.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在正门旁等候，直到导游拿回足够全组使用的门票。

senses.chinese: 与形容词连用，泛指某类人
senses.english: refers to a whole group with a shared quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The young can learn practical skills from older neighbours when they work together on community projects.
senses.exampleChinese: 年轻人与年长邻居一起参与社区项目时，能从他们身上学习实用技能。

senses.english: links two changing amounts or qualities
senses.exampleEnglish: The more we discussed the design, the easier it became to understand why the original version had failed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们讨论设计越深入，就越容易理解原版为何失败。

senses.english: To exist; to be alive; used to give information about someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The old library will be a community centre once the building work has finally been completed.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧图书馆在施工全部完成后将成为一个社区中心。

senses.english: exist or be in a place
senses.exampleEnglish: There used to be a small bakery here before the old station was converted into apartments.
senses.exampleChinese: 老车站改成公寓前，这里曾有一家小面包店。

senses.chinese: 与现在分词构成进行时
senses.english: forms continuous verb tenses
senses.exampleEnglish: We are repairing the wooden chairs this afternoon, so visitors will need to sit in the garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们今天下午正在修木椅，因此游客需要坐到花园里。

senses.chinese: 与过去分词构成被动语态
senses.english: forms passive verb constructions
senses.exampleEnglish: The damaged bridge will be repaired next month if the necessary materials arrive before the holiday begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果所需材料在假期开始前到货，损坏的桥将在下个月修复。

senses.english: expresses an arrangement or official requirement
senses.exampleEnglish: All volunteers are to meet outside the library before the organiser explains which tasks need finishing first.
senses.exampleChinese: 所有志愿者须在图书馆外集合，然后由组织者说明优先完成哪些任务。

senses.english: used to join two or more things
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum offers guided tours and practical workshops, so visitors can learn in several different ways.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆提供导览和实践工作坊，让游客能用几种不同方式学习。

phrases.english: and other similar things
phrases.exampleEnglish: The workshop provides paper, brushes, glue, and so on, but participants should bring their own notebooks.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊提供纸、画笔、胶水等等，但参与者应自带笔记本。

senses.english: belonging to or connected with something
senses.exampleEnglish: The roof of the old station was damaged, so passengers had to use another entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 老车站的屋顶受损，因此乘客不得不使用另一个入口。

senses.chinese: 表示数量、单位或容器的内容
senses.english: introduces a quantity or the contents of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We carried two bottles of water because there were no shops along the route through the forest.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们带了两瓶水，因为穿越森林的路线沿途没有商店。

senses.chinese: 属于整体的一部分；其中的
senses.english: connects a part or member to a whole
senses.exampleEnglish: Several of the visitors had never used a map before, so the guide explained the symbols carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位游客以前没用过地图，因此导游仔细解释了符号。

senses.chinese: 具有某种特点；由某物构成
senses.english: describes a quality or what something consists of
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition includes a collection of wooden toys that were made by local families during the winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览包括当地家庭在冬天制作的一批木制玩具。

senses.english: move towards; in the direction of
senses.exampleEnglish: We walked to the harbour after dinner because my sister wanted to photograph the fishing boats.
senses.exampleChinese: 晚饭后我们步行去港口，因为姐姐想拍摄渔船。

senses.chinese: 放在动词原形前，构成不定式
senses.english: marks the infinitive form of a verb
senses.exampleEnglish: We hope to finish the repairs before winter makes it difficult to work outside for long periods.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们希望在冬天让长时间户外作业变困难之前完成维修。

senses.english: introduces a recipient or person affected
senses.exampleEnglish: Please explain the new arrangement to the visitors before they enter the smaller rooms beside the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客进入大厅旁的小房间前，请向他们解释新的安排。

senses.chinese: 直到；到某一时间或程度
senses.english: indicates an ending point in time or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The library stays open from nine to six, although the reading room closes earlier during the holidays.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆九点开到六点，但假期阅览室会提前关闭。

senses.english: one (of something)
senses.exampleEnglish: During the journey, a passenger offered me a seat when she noticed my heavy bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅途中，一位乘客注意到我沉重的包，便给我让了座。

senses.chinese: 泛指某类人或事物中的任意一个
senses.english: refers to any member of a class
senses.exampleEnglish: A good map can help walkers avoid dangerous paths, especially when mobile phones cannot receive a signal.
senses.exampleChinese: 一张好地图能帮助徒步者避开危险小路，尤其是在手机没有信号时。

senses.english: means each when giving a rate or frequency
senses.exampleEnglish: The club meets twice a month so that members have enough time to practise between the workshops.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部每月聚会两次，让成员在工作坊之间有足够时间练习。

senses.english: being inside something
senses.exampleEnglish: The documents were still in my backpack, although I thought I had left them at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 文件仍在我的背包里，尽管我以为自己把它们落在家里了。

senses.chinese: 在某段时间；在多久以后
senses.english: indicates a period or the time before something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The new exhibition opens in June, and the organisers expect to finish preparing the rooms in two weeks.
senses.exampleChinese: 新展览六月开幕，组织者预计两周后完成房间布置。

senses.chinese: 处于某种状态；以某种方式或语言
senses.english: describes a state, form, or language
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions are written in plain English so that visitors can understand them without asking for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明使用浅显英语书写，让游客不用求助也能看懂。

senses.english: inside a place or moving into it
senses.exampleEnglish: Please come in through the side door because the main entrance is being used for a delivery.
senses.exampleChinese: 请从侧门进来，因为正门正在用于收货。

phrases.english: before an event or a required time
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please book your place in advance because the small workshop can only accommodate a limited number of visitors.
phrases.exampleChinese: 请提前预订，因为这个小工作坊只能接待有限人数。

senses.english: to own, possess, or hold something
senses.exampleEnglish: We have a spare room upstairs, so my cousin can stay whenever she visits the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们楼上有一间空房，所以表妹来这座城市时随时可以住下。

senses.english: experience something or perform an everyday activity
senses.exampleEnglish: We usually have lunch together after the workshop, which gives everyone a chance to discuss their ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊后我们通常一起吃午饭，让每个人都有机会讨论想法。

senses.english: arrange for someone to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: We had the old windows repaired before winter because replacing them would have cost far more money.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们入冬前找人修好了旧窗户，因为换窗要贵得多。

senses.chinese: 与过去分词构成完成时
senses.english: forms perfect verb tenses
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers have already painted the benches, so we can concentrate on planting the garden this weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者已经粉刷了长椅，因此这周末我们可以专心种植花园。

senses.english: need or be required to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: We have to book the room before Friday, otherwise another group may reserve it for the same evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们必须周五前预订房间，否则另一组可能订走同一晚的时段。

senses.english: used to refer to a thing that is known
senses.exampleEnglish: I bought a second-hand bicycle last month, and it has made my journey to work much easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 我上个月买了一辆二手自行车，它让我的上班路程轻松多了。

senses.chinese: 用于天气、时间、距离等无人称表达
senses.english: an impersonal subject for weather, time, or distance
senses.exampleEnglish: It was getting dark when we reached the village, so we looked for somewhere to stay overnight.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到村里时天快黑了，因此找了个过夜的地方。

senses.chinese: 作形式主语或宾语，代指后面的内容
senses.english: stands for a later clause or infinitive
senses.exampleEnglish: It is important to check the weather before leaving, especially when the route passes through the mountains.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前查看天气很重要，尤其是路线要经过山区时。

senses.english: used to refer to a person someone is speaking or writing to
senses.exampleEnglish: If you explain the problem clearly, the support team will be able to help more quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果你清楚地说明问题，支持团队就能更快地提供帮助。

senses.english: refers to people in general
senses.exampleEnglish: You can often learn more from explaining a problem to someone else than from studying it alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 向别人解释一个问题，常常比独自研究能学到更多。

senses.english: used to refer to the male person or animal that is known
senses.exampleEnglish: My brother wanted to become a chef, so he started helping in a restaurant after school.
senses.exampleChinese: 我弟弟想当厨师，所以放学后开始在一家餐馆帮忙。

senses.english: used to show the purpose, or need of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought a small tent for our weekend trip, hoping the weather would stay dry.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为周末旅行买了一顶小帐篷，希望天气保持晴朗。

senses.english: intended for or given to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought a small notebook for each participant so that everyone could record useful ideas during the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们给每位参与者买了小笔记本，让大家记录工作坊中的有用想法。

senses.english: indicates how long something lasts
senses.exampleEnglish: The bridge will remain closed for three weeks while workers replace the damaged wooden boards near the entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人更换入口附近损坏木板期间，桥将关闭三周。

senses.english: in support of someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Most residents voted for the proposal because it would make travelling to the town centre much easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 多数居民投票赞成提案，因为它会让前往镇中心更方便。

senses.english: in exchange for something or at a stated price
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought the second-hand table for a reasonable price, although it needed some repairs before we could use it.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们以合理价格买下二手桌，但使用前还需要修一修。

senses.english: because of a reason or cause
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide thanked us for arriving early, since the narrow entrance became crowded shortly after the doors opened.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游感谢我们提前到达，因为开门后不久狭窄入口就挤满了人。

senses.english: because, especially in formal writing
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to return before sunset, for the path through the forest was difficult to follow after dark.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定日落前返回，因为天黑后很难辨认穿林小路。

senses.english: used to refer to two or more people, animals, or things that are known
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers arrived before sunrise because they needed enough time to prepare the outdoor stage.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者们日出前就到了，因为他们需要足够时间准备户外舞台。

senses.chinese: 指性别不明、无须说明或使用该代词的一个人
senses.english: refers to one person without specifying gender
senses.exampleEnglish: If anyone finds a missing ticket, they should hand it to the organiser waiting beside the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 若有人找到丢失的票，应交给在正门旁等候的组织者。

senses.english: word indicating the negative of verbs, adjectives, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The tickets are not refundable, so please check the travel dates carefully before you book.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些票不能退款，因此预订前请仔细核对出行日期。

phrases.english: not in any way, or a polite response to thanks
phrases.exampleEnglish: The instructions were not at all confusing once the guide showed us how the different parts fitted together.
phrases.exampleChinese: 导游演示各部件如何拼接后，说明就一点也不难懂了。

senses.english: used to show which person or thing we are talking about
senses.exampleEnglish: Several boxes looked similar, but that was the one containing the photographs we had been searching for.
senses.exampleChinese: 几个箱子看起来很像，但那个才装着我们一直寻找的照片。

senses.english: identifies a particular person or thing farther away
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you move that chair beside the window so that visitors can walk through the room more easily?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能把那把椅子移到窗边，让游客更容易穿过房间吗？

senses.english: introduces a statement or reported information
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained that the building had once been a school before it became a community centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释说，这栋楼成为社区中心前曾是一所学校。

senses.chinese: 引导限定性定语从句，指人或物
senses.english: introduces a clause identifying a person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The map that you gave us showed a shorter route, which helped us reach the village before sunset.
senses.exampleChinese: 你给我们的地图标出一条更短路线，帮助我们日落前到达村里。

senses.english: to a particular degree or extent
senses.exampleEnglish: The hill was not that steep, although the loose stones made climbing it more tiring than we expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 山坡没那么陡，但松动的石头让攀爬比预期更累。

senses.english: used to refer to the speaker and other people together
senses.exampleEnglish: Although the route was longer than expected, we reached the village before the last bus left.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然路线比预期长，但我们在末班车离开前到达了村子。

senses.english: located on the surface of something (e.g., a table or wall)
senses.exampleEnglish: Please leave the parcel on the kitchen table, where my neighbour will find it this evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把包裹放在厨房桌子上，我邻居今晚会在那里找到它。

senses.english: indicates a day or date
senses.exampleEnglish: The library opens late on Thursdays so that people finishing work in the evening can borrow books.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆周四营业到较晚，方便傍晚下班的人借书。

senses.english: concerning a topic or subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide gave a short talk on local history before showing us the photographs displayed upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游先简短介绍地方历史，再带我们看楼上展出的照片。

senses.english: operating or continuing
senses.exampleEnglish: The heating was still on when we arrived, so the room felt comfortable despite the cold weather outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到达时暖气还开着，因此尽管外面寒冷，房间仍很舒适。

senses.english: wearing a piece of clothing
senses.exampleEnglish: She kept her coat on during the demonstration because the large room had not yet warmed up.
senses.exampleChinese: 演示时她一直穿着外套，因为大房间还没暖和起来。

phrases.english: intentionally rather than accidentally
phrases.exampleEnglish: She left a space on purpose so that visitors could add their own comments beside the photographs.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她故意留出空间，让游客能在照片旁写自己的评论。

phrases.english: at the agreed or expected time
phrases.exampleEnglish: We reached the station on time because our neighbour had warned us about the repairs on the main road.
phrases.exampleChinese: 邻居提醒了我们主路维修，因此我们准时到了车站。

senses.english: used to express that people or things are together
senses.exampleEnglish: I travelled with two colleagues who knew the area well and suggested several interesting places to visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 我和两位熟悉当地的同事同行，他们推荐了几个有趣的游览地点。

senses.english: using a tool or material
senses.exampleEnglish: We repaired the shelf with basic tools, following a diagram that our neighbour had drawn for us.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们用基本工具，按照邻居画的图修好了架子。

senses.english: having a particular feature or containing something
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a room with large windows because natural light would make it easier to examine the photographs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选了带大窗的房间，因为自然光方便仔细查看照片。

senses.chinese: 以某种态度、状态或方式
senses.english: describes a manner, attitude, or accompanying state
senses.exampleEnglish: The children listened with great interest while the guide explained how people had lived in the old house.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游讲述人们过去如何在老房子里生活时，孩子们听得很有兴趣。

phrases.english: concerning a particular subject
phrases.exampleEnglish: We will contact everyone with regard to the new schedule once the organiser has confirmed the final dates.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者确认最终日期后，我们会联系大家说明新日程。

senses.english: person, thing, or idea near you
senses.exampleEnglish: I have compared several routes, and this is the one that gives us the best coastal views.
senses.exampleChinese: 我比较了几条路线，这条能让我们欣赏到最好的海岸景色。

senses.english: identifies something nearby or currently being discussed
senses.exampleEnglish: We should finish this task before lunch so that the room will be ready for the afternoon group.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应在午饭前完成这项任务，让房间能接待下午那组人。

senses.english: used by a speaker or writer to refer to himself/herself
senses.exampleEnglish: Although I had never repaired a bicycle before, I managed to replace the broken chain myself.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然我以前从没修过自行车，但还是设法自己更换了断掉的链条。

senses.english: to act; to perform actions
senses.exampleEnglish: We should do the most difficult tasks first, while everyone still has plenty of energy.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该先做最难的任务，趁大家精力还很充沛。

senses.english: forms questions, negatives, and emphatic statements
senses.exampleEnglish: Do you know whether the museum stays open late, or should we call before leaving the hotel?
senses.exampleChinese: 你知道博物馆是否营业到晚些时候吗，还是我们该出酒店前先打电话？

senses.english: be enough or suitable
senses.exampleEnglish: The smaller table will do for now, although we may need a larger one when more visitors arrive.
senses.exampleChinese: 小桌子暂时够用，不过游客增加时可能需要更大的。

phrases.english: manage despite not having something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We can do without the projector today because the diagrams are large enough for everyone to see clearly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 今天没有投影仪也行，因为图足够大，大家都能看清。

senses.english: a word used to compare two equal things
senses.exampleEnglish: The replacement battery lasts as long as the original, although it costs considerably less to buy.
senses.exampleChinese: 替换电池的续航和原装一样长，购买价格却低很多。

senses.english: in a particular role or function
senses.exampleEnglish: She worked as a volunteer at the museum before accepting a full-time job with its education team.
senses.exampleChinese: 她先在博物馆当志愿者，之后才接受教育团队的全职工作。

senses.english: while something happens or changes
senses.exampleEnglish: As the room became darker, the guide switched on a small lamp to show the paintings more clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间渐暗时，导游打开小灯，让画作看得更清楚。

senses.english: because or since
senses.exampleEnglish: As several visitors had arrived late, the organiser repeated the instructions before allowing everyone to begin the activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于几位游客迟到，组织者重讲说明后才让大家开始活动。

senses.english: in the way that someone says or something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: Please leave the equipment as you found it so that the next group can start without delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把设备恢复原样，让下一组能及时开始。

phrases.english: in addition to something else
phrases.exampleEnglish: The ticket includes access to the garden as well as a guided tour through the main building.
phrases.exampleChinese: 门票除主楼导览之外，还包括进入花园的权限。

phrases.english: in a way that suggests something
phrases.exampleEnglish: He explained the route as if we already knew the area, although none of us had visited before.
phrases.exampleChinese: 他解释路线时仿佛我们已熟悉当地，但我们都没来过。

senses.english: in the place where something is
senses.exampleEnglish: We agreed to meet at the main entrance because the exhibition centre has several smaller doors.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们约定在正门见面，因为展览中心还有几个较小的门。

senses.english: indicates a particular time or age
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop begins at nine, but visitors can arrive earlier to look around the small exhibition downstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊九点开始，不过游客可提早来看看楼下的小展览。

senses.chinese: 在某方面；针对某种活动
senses.english: relates an ability or reaction to something
senses.exampleEnglish: She is good at explaining difficult ideas, which makes her lessons useful for learners with different backgrounds.
senses.exampleChinese: 她擅长讲解难懂概念，因此课程对不同背景的学习者都很有用。

senses.chinese: 以某个价格、速度或数值
senses.english: indicates a price, speed, or level
senses.exampleEnglish: The train travelled at a slower speed through the mountains, giving us more time to enjoy the scenery.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车过山区时速度较慢，让我们有更多时间欣赏风景。

senses.english: used to refer to the female person or animal that is known
senses.exampleEnglish: Our neighbour grows vegetables on her balcony, and she often shares the extra tomatoes with us.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居在阳台种菜，她经常把多余的番茄分给我们。

senses.english: used before you say something different, opposite
senses.exampleEnglish: The apartment is smaller than we expected, but its large windows make every room feel bright.
senses.exampleChinese: 这套公寓比我们预期的小，但大窗户让每个房间都很明亮。

senses.english: except for someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone but the organiser had left the hall when we returned to collect the equipment we had borrowed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们回来取借用设备时，除了组织者，大家都已离开大厅。

senses.english: starting at a particular place, time, or level
senses.exampleEnglish: The walking route begins from the old bridge and continues along the river towards the forest.
senses.exampleChinese: 这条步行路线从老桥开始，沿河一直通往森林方向。

collocations.chinese: 从一个地方到另一个地方

senses.english: indicates a source or origin
senses.exampleEnglish: We received useful advice from a neighbour who had repaired similar windows before moving into our street.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位搬来之前修过类似窗户的邻居给了我们有用建议。

senses.english: indicates what causes a state or effect
senses.exampleEnglish: The wooden boards were still wet from the rain, so we waited before carrying them into the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 木板仍被雨淋得湿漉漉，因此我们等了一会儿再搬进工作间。

senses.english: near; with
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited by the ticket office, where a member of staff explained why the train was delayed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在售票处旁等候，一名工作人员在那里解释了火车晚点的原因。

senses.english: identifies the person performing a passive action
senses.exampleEnglish: The photographs were taken by local residents who wanted to record how their neighbourhood was changing.
senses.exampleChinese: 照片由当地居民拍摄，他们想记录社区的变化。

senses.english: indicates a method or means
senses.exampleEnglish: We saved time by checking the measurements before buying the wood, rather than correcting mistakes during construction.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们买木材前先核对尺寸，省去了施工中改错的时间。

senses.english: no later than a stated time
senses.exampleEnglish: Please return the borrowed tools by Friday so that the next group can use them over the weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 请周五前归还借用工具，让下一组周末可以使用。

collocations.english: by the end of the week

senses.english: indicates the amount of a change or difference
senses.exampleEnglish: The new route shortened our journey by ten minutes, although it involved walking up a rather steep hill.
senses.exampleChinese: 新路线把路程缩短了十分钟，不过得走上一段很陡的坡。

senses.english: past a place or person
senses.exampleEnglish: We stood beside the road and watched the parade pass by before following the crowd towards the square.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们站在路边看游行队伍经过，再随人群前往广场。

phrases.english: introduces an additional comment or question
phrases.exampleEnglish: The map is useful, and by the way, you can collect a free copy at the village library.
phrases.exampleChinese: 地图很有用，顺便说一句，你可以到村图书馆领取免费副本。

phrases.english: without planning or intending it
phrases.exampleEnglish: We found the little museum by accident while looking for somewhere quiet to eat our packed lunches.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们寻找安静地方吃自带午餐时，偶然发现了小博物馆。

senses.english: used with verbs to express the future
senses.exampleEnglish: The new sports centre will open next spring, provided that the final building checks go well.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果最后的建筑检查顺利，新体育中心将于明年春天开放。

senses.english: expresses willingness or a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: I will help you carry the boxes upstairs if someone else can keep the narrow doorway clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果有人能让狭窄门口保持畅通，我愿意帮你把箱子搬上楼。

senses.english: determination to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her will to finish the project remained strong even when several unexpected problems delayed the building work.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使几个意外问题拖延了施工，她完成项目的决心仍很坚定。

senses.english: a legal statement of wishes after death
senses.exampleEnglish: His grandfather's will left the old house to the family, along with clear instructions about protecting its garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 祖父的遗嘱把老房子留给家人，并明确说明要保护花园。

senses.english: used to link alternatives, to introduce another choice
senses.exampleEnglish: You can submit the form online or bring a printed copy to the office before Friday.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以在周五之前在线提交表格，或把打印件带到办公室。

senses.english: introduces a consequence if something is not done
senses.exampleEnglish: We must leave before the afternoon traffic starts, or we may miss the last ferry to the island.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们必须在下午交通繁忙前离开，否则可能错过上岛的末班渡船。

collocations.english: hurry or we will be late

senses.english: introduces an alternative name or explanation
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop focuses on sustainable design, or making useful objects while causing less damage to the environment.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊关注可持续设计，也就是制作实用物品同时减少环境损害。

senses.english: to use words to tell a message
senses.exampleEnglish: Please say what you really think about the design, because we still have time to improve it.
senses.exampleChinese: 请说出你对设计的真实看法，因为我们还有时间改进。

senses.english: communicate information in writing or signs
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice says that visitors should leave large bags downstairs before entering the small rooms on the upper floor.
senses.exampleChinese: 告示写着，游客进入楼上小房间前应把大包留在楼下。

senses.chinese: 发表意见的权利；决定权
senses.english: an opportunity to express an opinion or influence a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone should have a say in the new timetable because the changes will affect the whole team.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个人都应有权对新时间表发表意见，因为变动会影响整个团队。

phrases.english: have an opportunity to influence a decision
phrases.exampleEnglish: The organisers want every volunteer to have a say before they decide how to divide the afternoon tasks.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者想让每位志愿者先发表意见，再决定如何分配下午任务。

phrases.english: introduces a clearer explanation
phrases.exampleEnglish: We need reusable materials, that is to say, things we can collect and use again after the workshop.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们需要可重复使用的材料，也就是说，工作坊后可收集再用的东西。

senses.english: to move or travel to another place
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to go to the smaller museum, which had an excellent exhibition about local history.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定去那家较小的博物馆，那里有很精彩的地方历史展。

senses.english: change to a particular state
senses.exampleEnglish: The room went quiet when the guide opened the box and showed us the carefully preserved photographs.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游打开盒子，展示精心保存的照片时，房间安静了下来。

senses.english: work or operate
senses.exampleEnglish: The old clock would not go after we moved it, so a neighbour offered to examine the mechanism.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧钟搬动后不走了，因此邻居主动提出检查机芯。

senses.english: lead or extend in a direction
senses.exampleEnglish: The narrow path goes all the way to the coast, passing several farms that sell fresh produce.
senses.exampleChinese: 窄路一直通到海岸，经过几家出售新鲜农产品的农场。

senses.english: fit or be suitable together
senses.exampleEnglish: The smaller shelves go well with the old desk, making the room look brighter without changing its character.
senses.exampleChinese: 小架子和旧书桌很相配，让房间更明亮又保留原有特色。

phrases.english: continue an activity or happening
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please go on with your explanation while I find the diagrams that show how the different parts fit together.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我找各部件拼接示意图时，请继续讲解。

phrases.english: experience something or examine it carefully
phrases.exampleEnglish: We should go through the instructions together before trying to assemble the model with the younger children.
phrases.exampleChinese: 和较小的孩子组装模型前，我们应一起仔细读说明。

phrases.english: start or proceed with something
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can go ahead with the painting once the organiser has checked that the wooden surface is completely dry.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者确认木面完全干燥后，你就可以开始涂漆了。

phrases.chinese: 发出警报；变质；突然停止运行
phrases.english: sound an alarm, become bad, or stop working
phrases.exampleEnglish: The alarm may go off during the test, but visitors should stay where they are until staff give instructions.
phrases.exampleChinese: 测试时警报可能响起，但游客应留在原地等工作人员指示。

phrases.english: leave home for an activity or stop burning
phrases.exampleEnglish: We usually go out for dinner after the workshop, especially when visitors want to continue discussing their ideas.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊后我们通常外出吃饭，尤其是游客还想继续讨论想法时。

senses.english: for that reason
senses.exampleEnglish: The road through the mountains was closed, so our driver had to find a different route.
senses.exampleChinese: 穿山公路封闭了，所以司机不得不另找一条路线。

senses.english: to such a great degree
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were so clear that every participant finished the model without needing any extra help from the guide.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明如此清楚，每位参与者都没额外求助就完成了模型。

senses.chinese: 代替前面提到的情况或说法
senses.english: refers back to an idea already mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: I think so, although we should ask the organiser whether the room will still be available after lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 我想是这样，不过我们应问组织者午饭后房间是否仍可使用。

senses.english: indicates that the same statement applies to someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: My brother enjoys repairing old furniture, and so do I, especially when we can work on a project together.
senses.exampleChinese: 我哥哥喜欢修旧家具，我也一样，尤其是能一起做项目时。

senses.english: completely; totally
senses.exampleEnglish: By the time the guests arrived, the children were all dressed and ready for the celebration.
senses.exampleChinese: 客人们到达时，孩子们都已穿戴整齐，准备参加庆祝活动。

senses.english: every member or the whole amount
senses.exampleEnglish: All the windows had to stay closed while workers cleaned the old paint from the outside walls.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人清理外墙旧漆时，所有窗户都必须关着。

senses.english: everyone or everything in a group
senses.exampleEnglish: All of us agreed to return the following weekend because several useful repairs still needed to be completed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们都同意下周末再来，因为还有几项必要维修没完成。

phrases.english: introduces a reason or a result contrary to expectation
phrases.exampleEnglish: We decided to keep the old table after all, because its damaged surface could easily be repaired.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们最终还是决定保留旧桌子，因为受损桌面很容易修好。

phrases.english: more importantly than anything else
phrases.exampleEnglish: The activity should be interesting and practical, but above all it must be safe for the youngest participants.
phrases.exampleChinese: 活动要有趣又实用，但最重要的是确保最年幼参与者安全。

phrases.english: suddenly and unexpectedly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The room became quiet all of a sudden when the guide brought out a box of unusually old photographs.
phrases.exampleChinese: 导游拿出一盒年代久远的照片时，房间突然安静下来。

senses.english: introducing a condition for something to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: If the weather improves by lunchtime, we can finish our picnic and explore the nearby village.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果午饭前天气好转，我们就能吃完野餐，再去逛附近的村子。

senses.english: introduces an indirect question
senses.exampleEnglish: Please ask if the museum has space for our group before booking transport for the whole afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 请先问博物馆能否容纳我们这组人，再预订整个下午的交通。

phrases.english: in a way that suggests something
phrases.exampleEnglish: She spoke as if everyone knew the story, although several visitors had only arrived a few minutes earlier.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她说话时仿佛人人都知道故事，但有几位游客才来几分钟。

phrases.english: expresses a strong wish about an unreal situation
phrases.exampleEnglish: If only the room were larger, we could invite the whole group instead of limiting the number of participants.
phrases.exampleChinese: 要是房间更大就好了，我们就能邀请全组而不必限制人数。

senses.english: number 1
senses.exampleEnglish: Only one seat was available on the earlier train, so we decided to travel together later.
senses.exampleChinese: 早一班火车只剩一个座位，所以我们决定晚些一起走。

senses.chinese: 代指前述同类事物中的一个
senses.english: a person or thing of a type already mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: The larger bag was too heavy, so I chose a smaller one that could fit under the seat.
senses.exampleChinese: 大包太重，所以我选了一个能放在座位下面的小包。

senses.english: people in general, used formally
senses.exampleEnglish: One should check the weather carefully before walking in unfamiliar mountains, even when the morning seems clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 在不熟悉的山区徒步前，人们应该仔细查看天气，即使早晨看着晴朗。

senses.english: a particular but unspecified person or occasion
senses.exampleEnglish: One afternoon, a visitor brought photographs that helped us identify the people shown in the museum's oldest display.
senses.exampleChinese: 某天下午，一位游客带来照片，帮助我们认出最早展品中的人物。

senses.english: modal verb used to indicate possibility, request, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: Would you mind explaining the instructions again, since several people joined after the meeting had started?
senses.exampleChinese: 你介意再解释一次说明吗？因为有几个人在会议开始后才加入。

senses.english: the future viewed from a past time
senses.exampleEnglish: We knew the journey would take longer after the bridge closed, so we left the village before sunrise.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们知道桥关闭后路程会更久，因此日出前就离村了。

senses.english: describes an imagined situation or result
senses.exampleEnglish: A larger table would make the workshop easier to organise, but we have no space to store one.
senses.exampleChinese: 更大的桌子会让工作坊更易组织，但我们没有地方存放。

senses.english: describes repeated actions in the past
senses.exampleEnglish: During the summer holidays, our grandfather would take us to the river and explain how the old mill worked.
senses.exampleChinese: 暑假里，爷爷常带我们去河边，讲解老磨坊如何运作。

phrases.english: would prefer to do something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We would rather walk through the village than take the bus, provided that the weather remains dry.
phrases.exampleChinese: 只要不下雨，我们宁愿走路穿过村子，也不坐公交车。

senses.english: of (a subject); concerning
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide told us about the castle's history while we climbed the narrow stairs to the tower.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们爬上通往塔楼的狭窄楼梯时，导游给我们讲了城堡的历史。

senses.english: approximately
senses.exampleEnglish: The walk takes about two hours if you stop to explore the villages and take photographs along the way.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果沿途逛村庄并拍照，这次步行大约需要两小时。

senses.english: around a place or in various positions
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide pointed to objects scattered about the room and explained how each had been used in daily life.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游指着房间各处的物件，解释它们以前在日常生活中的用途。

phrases.english: going to happen very soon
phrases.exampleEnglish: We were about to leave the station when the guide called to say that our bus had been delayed.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们正要离开车站，导游来电说我们的公交车晚点了。

senses.english: to be able to; have the skill to; have the time to
senses.exampleEnglish: With a little practice, you can prepare this meal in less time than it takes to order food.
senses.exampleChinese: 稍加练习，你做出这顿饭的时间就能比点外卖还短。

senses.english: be allowed to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors can take photographs in the garden, but they must ask permission before using cameras inside the house.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客可以在花园拍照，但在屋内用相机前必须征求许可。

senses.english: expresses a general possibility
senses.exampleEnglish: The coastal path can become slippery after heavy rain, so walkers should wear shoes with a good grip.
senses.exampleChinese: 大雨后沿海小路可能变滑，因此徒步者应穿防滑鞋。

senses.english: a metal container for food or drink
senses.exampleEnglish: We collected the empty cans after the picnic and checked where they could be recycled in the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 野餐后我们收集了空罐，并查询村里哪里可以回收。

senses.english: preserve food in sealed containers
senses.exampleEnglish: The family can their summer fruit so that they can enjoy it when fresh produce becomes less available.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人把夏季水果装罐保存，以便新鲜农产品少时也能吃到。

senses.english: question word to ask about a person's choice
senses.exampleEnglish: Which route would you recommend for visitors who want to avoid traffic and enjoy the countryside?
senses.exampleChinese: 对于想避开交通拥堵并欣赏乡村风景的游客，你会推荐哪条路线？

senses.chinese: 引导补充说明或限定事物的从句
senses.english: introduces information about a thing already mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed the river path, which eventually brought us to a small village that was not on our map.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们沿河边小路走，最终到了一座地图上没有的小村庄。

senses.english: asks for a choice between things
senses.exampleEnglish: We compared the two maps carefully before deciding which would be easier for the younger children to follow.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们仔细比较两张地图，再决定哪张更方便小孩子看懂。

senses.english: in that place or position, at that location
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent a weekend in the village and discovered that several artists had moved there recently.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在村里度过了一个周末，发现最近有几位艺术家搬到了那里。

senses.chinese: 用作存在句的形式主语
senses.english: introduces the existence of someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: There are several quiet places to sit in the garden, even when the main exhibition becomes crowded.
senses.exampleChinese: 花园里有几处安静的座位，即使主展览拥挤时也能坐。

senses.english: to have knowledge of things in your mind
senses.exampleEnglish: Although I know the main road well, I always check the map before trying a different route.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然我很熟悉主路，但尝试别的路线前总会查地图。

senses.english: be familiar with a person, place, or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: She knows the area well because she spent several summers helping her grandparents run the village shop.
senses.exampleChinese: 她很熟悉当地，因为几个暑假都曾帮祖父母经营村中商店。

senses.english: have the practical ability to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Not everyone knows how to repair a bicycle, so the instructor starts by demonstrating the simplest tasks slowly.
senses.exampleChinese: 并非人人都会修自行车，所以教练先慢慢演示最简单的任务。

senses.english: greater in amount, number, or size
senses.exampleEnglish: We need more volunteers for the weekend event because the number of visitors has increased considerably.
senses.exampleChinese: 周末活动需要更多志愿者，因为游客数量大幅增加了。

senses.english: to a greater degree
senses.exampleEnglish: The room became more comfortable once we moved the furniture and allowed natural light to reach the back wall.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们搬动家具，让自然光照到后墙后，房间舒适多了。

senses.english: a greater or additional amount
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought extra paper because more was needed to finish the posters before visitors arrived for the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们多买了纸，因为游客来看展前完成海报需要更多纸。

phrases.english: approximately or almost completely
phrases.exampleEnglish: The repairs are more or less finished, although we still need to clean the floor before visitors arrive.
phrases.exampleChinese: 维修基本完成，不过游客来前还需要清理地板。

senses.english: to obtain, receive, or be given something
senses.exampleEnglish: You can get a free map at reception, which shows all the walking routes around the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以在接待处领取免费地图，上面标着所有环湖步行路线。

senses.english: become or change to a state
senses.exampleEnglish: The path gets narrower beyond the bridge, so the group will need to walk one behind another.
senses.exampleChinese: 过桥后小路变窄，因此大家需要一个接一个走。

senses.english: arrive at a place
senses.exampleEnglish: We should get to the village before sunset if the train arrives at the station without any delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果火车准时到站，我们应该能日落前到村里。

senses.english: understand something, informally
senses.exampleEnglish: I did not get the joke at first because I had never heard the expression the speaker was using.
senses.exampleChinese: 起初我没听懂笑话，因为从没听过讲者用的那个表达。

senses.english: go and bring someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you get the spare chairs from upstairs while I explain the activity to the visitors waiting outside?
senses.exampleChinese: 我向外面等候的游客讲解活动时，你能去楼上取备用椅子吗？

senses.english: cause something to happen or persuade someone to act
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to get the windows repaired before winter makes the room too cold for the regular evening classes.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要在冬天使房间冷得无法正常上晚课前把窗修好。

phrases.english: have a friendly relationship with someone
phrases.exampleEnglish: Most volunteers get along with their neighbours, which makes it easier to organise practical projects for the whole street.
phrases.exampleChinese: 多数志愿者与邻居相处融洽，让整条街的实践项目更易组织。

phrases.english: recover from or overcome a difficulty
phrases.exampleEnglish: It took her several weeks to get over the disappointment, but she eventually returned to finish the project.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她花了几周克服失望，但最终还是回来完成了项目。

phrases.chinese: 做错事而未受惩罚或发现
phrases.english: avoid punishment or criticism for something wrong
phrases.exampleEnglish: Nobody should get away with damaging the equipment, because the whole group depends on it for their work.
phrases.exampleChinese: 损坏设备的人不该逃脱责任，因为全组工作都依靠这些设备。

senses.english: what or which person or people, to ask about, talking about
senses.exampleEnglish: Do you know who organised the workshop, because I would like to thank them for their help?
senses.exampleChinese: 你知道是谁组织了这次工作坊吗？我想感谢他们的帮助。

senses.english: introduces information identifying or describing a person
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteer who repaired the chairs will show visitors how to fix small problems with their own furniture.
senses.exampleChinese: 修好椅子的志愿者将教游客处理自家家具的小毛病。

senses.english: to find something pleasing; to prefer something
senses.exampleEnglish: I like working near the window because the natural light helps me concentrate during the afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 我喜欢在窗边工作，因为自然光能帮助我在下午集中注意力。

senses.english: similar to someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The new library looks like a traditional farmhouse, although its interior was designed for modern community activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 新图书馆外观像传统农舍，但内部是为现代社区活动设计的。

senses.english: introduces examples
senses.exampleEnglish: Simple tools like these are useful for beginners because they are easy to control and do not need electricity.
senses.exampleChinese: 这类简单工具适合初学者，因为易控制又不用电。

senses.english: a thing that someone enjoys or prefers
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser asked about our likes and dislikes before planning meals for the whole weekend at the campsite.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者安排整个周末露营餐食前，问了我们的喜好。

senses.english: word you use to ask about the time or day
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to decide when the course should begin so that everyone has enough time to prepare.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要决定课程何时开始，好让每个人都有足够时间准备。

senses.english: at the time that something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: We will begin the tour when everyone has arrived and the guide has checked that nobody needs extra help.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家到齐，导游确认无人需要额外帮助后，我们就开始导览。

senses.english: to have an idea, opinion, or belief about something
senses.exampleEnglish: I think the smaller venue would suit our event better, especially if fewer guests decide to come.
senses.exampleChinese: 我觉得较小的场地更适合我们的活动，尤其是在来宾减少的情况下。

senses.english: use your mind to consider something
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to think about the practical difficulties before agreeing to hold the whole event outdoors in winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 同意冬天把整个活动放在户外之前，我们需要考虑实际困难。

phrases.english: consider carefully before taking action
phrases.exampleEnglish: You should think twice before throwing the cupboard away, since a few small repairs could make it useful again.
phrases.exampleChinese: 扔掉橱柜前应再考虑，因为修几处小地方就能再用。

senses.english: to create something by putting things together
senses.exampleEnglish: The children used recycled cardboard to make a model bridge that could support several small toy cars.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们用回收纸板制作了一座能承受几辆小玩具车的桥模型。

senses.english: cause something to happen or someone to feel a certain way
senses.exampleEnglish: The new lighting made the room feel larger, although we had not changed the position of any furniture.
senses.exampleChinese: 新照明让房间显得更大，尽管我们没有移动任何家具。

senses.english: force or require someone to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher did not make us copy the whole text because she wanted us to explain it ourselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师没强迫我们抄全文，因为她想让我们自己解释。

senses.english: earn or gain money or profit
senses.exampleEnglish: The club hopes to make enough money from the fair to buy new tools for its practical workshops.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部希望通过集市赚够钱，为实践工作坊购买新工具。

senses.english: manage to reach or achieve something
senses.exampleEnglish: We might still make the last train if we leave the gallery now and walk straight to the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果现在离开画廊直奔车站，我们也许仍能赶上末班火车。

phrases.english: invent something, form a whole, or become friendly again
phrases.exampleEnglish: The children had to make up a story using the unusual objects they found inside the box.
phrases.exampleChinese: 孩子们要用箱里发现的独特物件编一个故事。

phrases.english: manage to see or understand something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We could barely make out the writing on the old sign because the letters had faded over time.
phrases.exampleChinese: 旧牌子的字迹随时间褪色了，我们几乎辨认不出来。

phrases.english: use an opportunity or resource as well as possible
phrases.exampleEnglish: We should make the most of the fine weather by finishing the outdoor repairs before the rain returns.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们应充分利用好天气，在再次下雨前完成户外维修。

senses.english: something measured in minutes, hours, days, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: We allowed extra time for the journey because the roads near the airport were being repaired.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为行程多留了时间，因为机场附近的道路正在维修。

senses.english: an occasion when something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The first time we visited the village, we missed the tiny museum hidden behind the old bakery.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一次游村时，我们错过了藏在老面包店后的小博物馆。

senses.english: a period in someone's life or in history
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition shows how families cooked and travelled during a time when very few homes had electricity.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览展示了很少家庭通电的年代，人们如何做饭和出行。

senses.english: measure how long something takes
senses.exampleEnglish: We will time each stage of the activity so that future groups know how long they should allow.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们会为活动每阶段计时，让后续小组知道该预留多久。

senses.english: arrange something to happen at a suitable moment
senses.exampleEnglish: We timed our arrival to avoid the busiest period, which gave us a peaceful view of the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们安排到达时间避开高峰，因此能安静欣赏展览。

phrases.english: occasionally
phrases.exampleEnglish: The organisers update the route from time to time when new paths become available around the village.
phrases.exampleChinese: 村边出现新小路时，组织者会不时更新路线。

phrases.english: early enough for something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We arrived in time to see the opening demonstration, even though our train had left the station late.
phrases.exampleChinese: 虽然火车晚点出站，我们还是及时赶上了开场演示。

phrases.english: do something without rushing
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please take your time when examining the photographs, since some of the most interesting details are very small.
phrases.exampleChinese: 看照片时请慢慢来，因为最有趣的细节有些很小。

senses.english: to use your eyes to look at something
senses.exampleEnglish: From the upstairs window, we could see fishing boats returning to the harbour as the sun rose.
senses.exampleChinese: 从楼上窗户，我们能看见渔船随着太阳升起驶回港口。

senses.english: understand or realise something
senses.exampleEnglish: I can see why the original plan failed now that you have explained how the booking system works.
senses.exampleChinese: 你解释预订系统如何运作后，我明白原计划为何失败了。

senses.english: meet or visit someone
senses.exampleEnglish: We will see our neighbours next weekend to thank them for helping us during the long house repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 下周末我们将去见邻居，感谢他们在漫长修房期间帮忙。

senses.chinese: 目睹；经历某种变化或事件
senses.english: witness or experience an event or change
senses.exampleEnglish: The town has seen many changes since the old railway opened and brought visitors from across the region.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧铁路开通并带来整个地区的游客后，镇上经历了许多变化。

phrases.english: take responsibility for dealing with something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Could you see to the visitors waiting outside while I check whether the smaller room is ready?
phrases.exampleChinese: 我检查小房间是否准备好时，你能照应一下外面等候的游客吗？

phrases.english: recognise the truth behind something misleading
phrases.exampleEnglish: The visitors could see through the excuse once they discovered that the organisers had never booked the room.
phrases.exampleChinese: 游客发现组织者从未订房间后，就识破了那个借口。

senses.english: asking for information about someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please explain what the new symbols mean before we start using the updated version of the map.
senses.exampleChinese: 在我们开始使用新版地图前，请解释一下这些新符号是什么意思。

senses.english: asks for the identity or kind of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please tell us what equipment you need before Friday so that we can prepare everything for the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 请周五前告诉我们需要什么设备，以便我们为工作坊准备齐全。

senses.english: introduces an exclamation about a quality
senses.exampleEnglish: What a wonderful view we had from the tower, especially after the clouds cleared above the distant hills!
senses.exampleChinese: 塔上景色多美啊，尤其是远山上方的云散开之后！

senses.english: move higher; raise
senses.exampleEnglish: The path climbs up the hillside before reaching a small café with wonderful views across the valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 小路沿山坡向上，最后通往一家能俯瞰山谷美景的小咖啡馆。

senses.english: at or towards a higher level or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The price of tickets has gone up since the museum added guided tours to its regular programme.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆在常规活动中加入导览后，票价上涨了。

senses.english: awake or in an upright position
senses.exampleEnglish: We were up before sunrise because the guide wanted to reach the harbour before the fishing boats returned.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们日出前就起床了，因为导游想赶在渔船返回前到港口。

senses.english: finished or at an end
senses.exampleEnglish: Our time was up before we had examined every photograph, so we arranged to return the following weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 没看完所有照片时间就到了，因此我们约定下周末再来。

phrases.chinese: 多达；由……决定；从事或筹划
phrases.english: as much as, decided by, or doing something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The workshop can welcome up to twenty visitors, but smaller groups have more time to practise each skill.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊最多接待二十位游客，但人少时人人有更多时间练习。

senses.english: used to refer to a person or thing that is not known
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought some fresh bread from the village bakery before setting off on our long journey home.
senses.exampleChinese: 在踏上漫长的回家路之前，我们在村里的面包店买了些新鲜面包。

senses.english: an unspecified number or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: Several visitors wanted maps, so we left some beside the entrance where everyone could collect a copy.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位游客想要地图，因此我们在入口留了一些，让大家自取。

senses.english: something else; not the first one
senses.exampleEnglish: The main entrance was closed for repairs, so visitors had to use the other door beside the café.
senses.exampleChinese: 正门因维修关闭，游客只好使用咖啡馆旁的另一扇门。

senses.english: another person or thing, or additional people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: One room was already full, but the other had enough space for everyone waiting beside the stairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 一间房已满，另一间却能容纳楼梯旁等候的所有人。

senses.english: away from the inside or center
senses.exampleEnglish: The children hurried out of the classroom when they heard that the snow had finally started falling.
senses.exampleChinese: 听说终于开始下雪了，孩子们急忙跑出了教室。

senses.english: away from home or the usual place
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager was out when we called, so we left a message explaining why the delivery needed changing.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们打电话时经理不在，因此留言说明为什么要调整配送。

senses.english: published, released, or publicly known
senses.exampleEnglish: The new guidebook is out now, and it includes several walking routes that were missing from earlier editions.
senses.exampleChinese: 新指南已经出版，收录了早期版本没有的几条步行路线。

senses.english: no longer burning or shining
senses.exampleEnglish: The lights were out when we reached the cottage, although our neighbours had promised to leave a lamp on.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到村舍时灯都灭了，尽管邻居答应留一盏灯。

phrases.english: not working or not arranged correctly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The ticket machine is out of order, so visitors should collect their reservations from the office beside the entrance.
phrases.exampleChinese: 售票机故障，因此游客应到入口旁办公室领取预订票。

senses.english: excellent; high quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel received good reviews because its staff were helpful and the rooms were carefully maintained.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家酒店获得了好评，因为员工热心，房间也维护得很好。

senses.english: skilful at a particular activity
senses.exampleEnglish: She is good at explaining complicated instructions, so beginners often ask her for help during the practical sessions.
senses.exampleChinese: 她擅长解释复杂说明，因此初学者常在实践课向她求助。

senses.english: helpful or beneficial for someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular breaks are good for concentration, especially when a task requires several hours of careful practical work.
senses.exampleChinese: 定期休息有助于专注，尤其是任务需要连续几小时仔细操作时。

senses.english: kind or morally right
senses.exampleEnglish: It was good of our neighbours to help with the repairs even though they had a busy weekend themselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居自己周末很忙却仍帮忙维修，实在很善良。

senses.english: benefit or advantage
senses.exampleEnglish: The quiet afternoon did us a great deal of good after several tiring days preparing the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 筹备展览累了几天后，安静度过的下午对我们很有益。

senses.english: products made to be sold
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop sells locally made goods so that visitors can support small businesses from the surrounding villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店销售本地商品，让游客支持周边村庄的小企业。

phrases.english: permanently
phrases.exampleEnglish: The old shop closed for good after its owner retired, although the building still stands beside the station.
phrases.exampleChinese: 店主退休后，老店永久关闭，但建筑仍立在车站旁。

senses.english: human beings in general; plural of person
senses.exampleEnglish: More people are choosing to cycle to work now that the city has built safer bicycle lanes.
senses.exampleChinese: 城市建起更安全的自行车道后，更多人选择骑车上班。

senses.chinese: 民族；某一共同文化群体
senses.english: a group sharing a culture or national identity
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition describes the traditions of a people whose crafts have influenced artists far beyond their own region.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览介绍一个民族的传统，其工艺影响了远超本地区的艺术家。

senses.english: unit of time equal to 12 months
senses.exampleEnglish: We visit the same village every year, although we usually explore a different area of the countryside each time.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们每年都去同一个村子，不过每次通常会探索不同的乡村区域。

senses.english: to pick up something and go away with it
senses.exampleEnglish: Please take your umbrella when you leave, because the forecast suggests that heavy rain will return later.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开时请带上雨伞，因为天气预报说稍后还会有大雨。

senses.english: accept or receive something offered
senses.exampleEnglish: You can take a free leaflet at the entrance, but please leave enough copies for visitors arriving later.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以在入口拿一份免费传单，但请给后来的游客留足。

senses.chinese: 花费；需要某种时间或条件
senses.english: require an amount of time, effort, or space
senses.exampleEnglish: The repairs will take longer than expected because several damaged parts must be made especially for the old machine.
senses.exampleChinese: 维修将比预期更久，因为几处损坏零件须为旧机器专门制作。

senses.english: consume medicine, food, or drink
senses.exampleEnglish: She remembered to take her medicine before leaving the hotel, so she did not need to interrupt the journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 她出酒店前记得服药，因此不用中断旅程。

senses.english: use transport or follow a particular route
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to take the earlier train so that we could explore the village before meeting the rest of the group.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定坐早班火车，集合前先逛村庄。

senses.english: make a photograph or record a measurement
senses.exampleEnglish: Please take a photograph of the finished model before the children begin moving it to the exhibition room.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们把成品模型搬去展厅前，请先拍张照片。

phrases.english: participate in an activity
phrases.exampleEnglish: Everyone can take part in the final activity, even if they have never used the tools before.
phrases.exampleChinese: 每个人都能参加最后活动，即使以前没用过这些工具。

phrases.english: remove clothing, leave the ground, or become successful
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please take off your muddy shoes before entering the house because the wooden floors have just been cleaned.
phrases.exampleChinese: 进屋前请脱掉泥鞋，因为木地板刚清理过。

phrases.english: take control or responsibility from someone else
phrases.exampleEnglish: Another volunteer will take over the reception desk while I show the new visitors around the garden.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我带新游客逛花园时，另一位志愿者将接替接待台。

phrases.english: consider a factor when making a decision
phrases.exampleEnglish: We should take into account the children's experience before choosing which walking route the whole group will follow.
phrases.exampleChinese: 决定全组走哪条路线前，应考虑孩子们的经验。

senses.english: being none; not having or being
senses.exampleEnglish: There was no space left in the cupboard, so we moved the extra plates to another room.
senses.exampleChinese: 橱柜里没有空间了，所以我们把多余的盘子移到了另一个房间。

senses.chinese: 不；不是；表示拒绝或否定
senses.english: a negative answer or refusal
senses.exampleEnglish: She said no when we offered to replace the old desk, explaining that it had belonged to her grandfather.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们提议换旧书桌时，她说不要，因为那是祖父留下的。

senses.english: not to any degree, especially with comparisons
senses.exampleEnglish: The new instructions were no clearer than the old ones, so we asked for a practical demonstration.
senses.exampleChinese: 新说明并不比旧的清楚，因此我们要求实际演示。

senses.english: in a good way
senses.exampleEnglish: The two teams work well together, even though they approach difficult problems in very different ways.
senses.exampleChinese: 这两个团队合作得很好，尽管他们处理难题的方式很不相同。

senses.english: in good health
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt well enough to join the walk after resting indoors while the others prepared the picnic.
senses.exampleChinese: 别人准备野餐时她在屋里休息，之后身体好到可以同行徒步了。

senses.english: to a considerable degree or distance
senses.exampleEnglish: The village lies well beyond the hills, so we will need more time than the map first suggests.
senses.exampleChinese: 村子远在山那边，因此需要的时间比地图初看显示的多。

senses.english: a deep hole from which water is drawn
senses.exampleEnglish: The old well provided water for the village before modern pipes connected every house to a shared supply.
senses.exampleChinese: 现代管道把家家户户接入统一供水前，村里靠这口老井取水。

senses.english: introduces a response, pause, or change of topic
senses.exampleEnglish: Well, we could visit the smaller gallery first if you would prefer to avoid the afternoon crowds.
senses.exampleChinese: 好吧，如果你想避开下午的人群，我们可以先参观小画廊。

phrases.english: in addition
phrases.exampleEnglish: The museum provides guided tours and practical workshops as well, so families can choose activities that suit different ages.
phrases.exampleChinese: 博物馆提供导览，也有实践工作坊，让家庭选择适合不同年龄的活动。

senses.english: for a reason
senses.exampleEnglish: We booked an earlier train because we wanted enough time to explore the city before the concert.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们订了更早的火车，因为想在音乐会前有足够时间游览城市。

phrases.english: as a result of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The outdoor workshop was moved into the hall because of the strong wind forecast for later that afternoon.
phrases.exampleChinese: 由于预报当天下午稍晚有强风，户外工作坊改到大厅。

senses.english: much; great in amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were very clear, so everyone managed to assemble the shelves without asking for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明非常清楚，所以大家不用寻求帮助就装好了架子。

senses.english: exact or particular, used for emphasis
senses.exampleEnglish: The missing key was in the very drawer we had searched twice before asking our neighbour for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 丢失的钥匙就在我们找邻居前已搜过两次的那个抽屉里。

senses.english: very recently
senses.exampleEnglish: I have just finished the report, so I can send you a copy before the afternoon meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 我刚刚完成报告，所以能在下午的会议前发给你一份。

senses.english: only and nothing more
senses.exampleEnglish: We need just one more volunteer to welcome visitors while the rest of the team prepares the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们只需再一名志愿者迎客，其余队员布置大厅。

senses.english: exactly or precisely
senses.exampleEnglish: The new shelf fits just where we wanted it, leaving enough space for people to pass the doorway.
senses.exampleChinese: 新架子恰好安在我们想要的位置，门边仍留足通行空间。

senses.english: by only a small amount or margin
senses.exampleEnglish: We just caught the last ferry after the taxi driver found a quicker route around the road repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 出租车司机找到绕开修路的捷径后，我们勉强赶上末班渡船。

senses.english: fair and morally right
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee wanted a just solution that considered the needs of residents as well as the businesses nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会希望找一个兼顾居民与附近企业需求的公正方案。

senses.english: to move toward someone; go with someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Please come to the community meeting if you would like to help improve our local park.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果你想帮助改善当地公园，请来参加社区会议。

senses.chinese: 提供；有售；具有某种形式
senses.english: be available in a form or variety
senses.exampleEnglish: The reusable bottles come in several sizes, so visitors can choose one that suits the length of their walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 可重复使用的水瓶有几种尺寸，游客可按徒步时长选择。

senses.english: happen or arrive at a particular stage
senses.exampleEnglish: The invitation came at the right moment because we had been hoping to share our project with a wider audience.
senses.exampleChinese: 邀请来得正是时候，因为我们一直希望向更多人介绍项目。

phrases.english: find or meet by chance
phrases.exampleEnglish: We might come across useful old photographs while sorting the boxes that our neighbours donated to the museum.
phrases.exampleChinese: 整理邻居捐给博物馆的箱子时，我们或许会偶然发现有用老照片。

phrases.english: think of an idea or solution
phrases.exampleEnglish: The students had to come up with a practical solution before they were allowed to start building their models.
phrases.exampleChinese: 学生们须先想出实用方案，才获准开始搭模型。

senses.english: used as the past form of can, to show possibility
senses.exampleEnglish: When we lived near the coast, we could walk to the beach after dinner almost every evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 以前住在海边时，我们几乎每晚饭后都能步行去海滩。

senses.english: expresses possibility or an imagined ability
senses.exampleEnglish: A small change to the timetable could help families attend the workshop without missing the last bus home.
senses.exampleChinese: 时间表稍作调整，或许能让家庭参加工作坊又不误返程末班车。

senses.english: introduces a polite request or suggestion
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you explain the final step again so that the visitors at the back can understand how it works?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能再讲一次最后步骤，让后排游客明白它如何操作吗？

senses.english: activity you do in order to make money
senses.exampleEnglish: She enjoys her work at the museum because every exhibition gives her an opportunity to learn something new.
senses.exampleChinese: 她喜欢博物馆的工作，因为每次展览都让她有机会学到新东西。

senses.english: do a job or activity requiring effort
senses.exampleEnglish: We work in small groups during the workshop so that everyone has a chance to practise each skill.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊中我们分小组操作，让每个人都有机会练习每项技能。

senses.english: function properly or produce the intended result
senses.exampleEnglish: The old clock still works, although a neighbour has to check its mechanism at the beginning of each winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧钟仍能走，不过邻居每年冬初都得检查机芯。

senses.english: an artistic or literary creation
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition includes early works by local artists who later became well known for their unusual use of colour.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览收录当地画家的早期作品，他们后来因独特用色而知名。

senses.english: tasks or effort needed to achieve something
senses.exampleEnglish: There is still plenty of work to do before the room is ready for the first group of visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间能接待首批游客前，还有不少工作要做。

senses.english: to do something with, for a task or purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: We use a shared calendar so that everyone knows when the meeting rooms are available for booking.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们使用共享日历，让大家都知道会议室何时可以预订。

senses.english: the act, purpose, or right of using something
senses.exampleEnglish: The leaflet explains the safe use of the equipment before giving examples of projects beginners can try.
senses.exampleChinese: 传单先讲设备的安全使用，再举例说明初学者可尝试的项目。

phrases.english: describes a past habit or state that no longer applies
phrases.exampleEnglish: We used to meet in the smaller room before the club grew large enough to need the main hall.
phrases.exampleChinese: 俱乐部扩大到需要大厅之前，我们过去常在小房间聚会。

phrases.english: be familiar and comfortable with something through experience
phrases.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will be used to the new booking system after they have practised with it for several weeks.
phrases.exampleChinese: 志愿者练习使用新预订系统几周后，就会习惯。

senses.english: used when comparing two things
senses.exampleEnglish: The new library is much quieter than the old one, making it easier for students to concentrate.
senses.exampleChinese: 新图书馆比旧馆安静得多，让学生们更容易集中注意力。

senses.english: at the present time or moment
senses.exampleEnglish: The bridge has reopened, and drivers can now reach the town without taking a long route through the hills.
senses.exampleChinese: 桥已经重新开放，司机们现在无需绕行山区就能到镇上。

senses.english: at that time not now
senses.exampleEnglish: We arrived in the village before sunrise, and the streets were almost completely empty back then.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们日出前到达村子，那时候街道上几乎完全没有人。

senses.english: next in time or order
senses.exampleEnglish: We will check the measurements first and then cut the wood so that we do not waste expensive materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先核对尺寸再切木料，以免浪费昂贵材料。

senses.english: introduces a conclusion from what was said
senses.exampleEnglish: If the smaller room is already booked, then we should ask whether the library can offer another space.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果小房间已被订走，那么我们应问图书馆是否有其他场地。

senses.english: in addition; too; in a similar way
senses.exampleEnglish: The course teaches practical cooking skills, but it also explains how to plan meals on a limited budget.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程教授实用烹饪技能，也讲解如何在预算有限的情况下安排膳食。

senses.english: going inside something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide led us into a narrow tunnel that connected the old house to the nearby river.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游带我们进入一条狭窄隧道，它把老房子和附近的河连接起来。

senses.english: indicates a change of form or state
senses.exampleEnglish: The old factory was turned into a community centre after residents suggested several useful ways to reuse it.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民提出几种实用再利用建议后，旧工厂被改成社区中心。

senses.english: interested or involved in an activity
senses.exampleEnglish: My sister is into photography, so she spent most of the visit examining how light entered the old building.
senses.exampleChinese: 姐姐热衷摄影，因此参观时大部分时间都在观察老建筑的采光。

senses.english: just one; just that amount or thing; not more than
senses.exampleEnglish: Only a few visitors stayed until closing time, so we had a peaceful view of the final exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 只有少数游客待到闭馆，所以我们能安静地欣赏最后一个展览。

senses.english: being the single person or thing of a kind
senses.exampleEnglish: The only available room was upstairs, which made carrying the heavy materials more difficult than we had expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 唯一空房在楼上，搬重材料比预期难多了。

senses.english: but, introducing a restriction
senses.exampleEnglish: We would stay for the afternoon tour, only the last bus leaves before the guide finishes showing visitors around.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们本想留下参加下午导览，只是末班车在导览结束前发车。

senses.english: to turn your eyes in a particular direction
senses.exampleEnglish: Please look at the diagram carefully before you connect the cables to the back of the computer.
senses.exampleChinese: 把电缆接到电脑背面之前，请仔细看一下示意图。

senses.english: seem or appear to have a quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The route looks short on the map, but the steep hills make it much harder than the distance suggests.
senses.exampleChinese: 地图上路线看起来很短，但陡坡使它远比距离显示的难走。

senses.english: an appearance or expression
senses.exampleEnglish: The fresh paint gave the room a brighter look without hiding the details that made the old building interesting.
senses.exampleChinese: 新漆让房间显得明亮，同时没有掩盖老建筑的有趣细节。

senses.english: an act of looking
senses.exampleEnglish: We took a quick look at the timetable before deciding whether there was enough time to visit the garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们快速看了时间表，再决定是否来得及游览花园。

phrases.english: take care of someone or something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Our neighbours offered to look after the plants while we spent a week helping relatives in another town.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们去另一镇帮亲戚一周时，邻居主动照料植物。

phrases.english: search for information or raise your eyes
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can look up unfamiliar words in the guide before asking the organiser to explain the more difficult instructions.
phrases.exampleChinese: 请组织者解释难懂说明前，可以先查指南里的生词。

phrases.english: feel pleased about something that will happen
phrases.exampleEnglish: We look forward to visiting the village again, especially now that the old garden has reopened to the public.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们期待再访村庄，尤其是老花园已重向公众开放。

phrases.english: investigate a problem or possibility
phrases.exampleEnglish: The committee will look into the parking problem before deciding whether the next event needs a different venue.
phrases.exampleChinese: 委员会会先调查停车问题，再决定下次活动是否换场地。

senses.english: to desire or wish for something; hope for a thing
senses.exampleEnglish: We want to find a quieter place to stay, preferably somewhere within walking distance of the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们想找一个更安静的住宿地点，最好离车站只有步行距离。

senses.english: a need or lack of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser asked about everyone's wants and needs before arranging meals for the group staying at the campsite.
senses.exampleChinese: 为营地团队安排餐食前，组织者询问了每个人的需求。

senses.english: to hand over or present something to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The receptionist will give you a visitor's badge after you have written your name in the book.
senses.exampleChinese: 你在登记簿上写下姓名后，接待员会给你一张访客证。

senses.chinese: 使产生；给予某种感受或结果
senses.english: cause someone to have a feeling or impression
senses.exampleEnglish: The demonstration gave us confidence to repair the smaller objects ourselves instead of immediately asking an expert.
senses.exampleChinese: 演示让我们有信心自己修小物件，而非立刻找专家。

senses.english: organise an event or perform something for others
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will give a short talk about local history before showing visitors the photographs collected during the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者先简短介绍地方历史，再展示项目收集的照片。

senses.english: bend, move, or yield under pressure
senses.exampleEnglish: The old boards began to give beneath our feet, so the guide quickly moved everyone onto the stone path.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧木板在脚下开始松动，导游赶紧让大家转到石路上。

phrases.english: stop doing or trying something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We did not want to give up the project simply because the first design had failed during testing.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们不想只因首个设计测试失败就放弃项目。

phrases.english: give freely or reveal a secret
phrases.exampleEnglish: The library plans to give away its spare copies so that local families can read the books at home.
phrases.exampleChinese: 图书馆计划赠送多余副本，让当地家庭能在家读书。

phrases.english: stop resisting or accept a demand
phrases.exampleEnglish: The organisers refused to give in to pressure to remove the safety checks before allowing visitors onto the tower.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者拒绝在压力下取消登塔前的安全检查。

senses.english: coming before all others in time or place
senses.exampleEnglish: Our first attempt failed because we had not checked whether all the pieces fitted together correctly.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们的第一次尝试失败了，因为没有检查所有零件是否正确吻合。

senses.english: before other people, things, or occasions
senses.exampleEnglish: We should check the weather first before deciding whether the younger children can join the longer walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定小孩子能否参加较长徒步前，我们应先查天气。

senses.chinese: 首次出现的事或首次成就
senses.english: something happening or achieved for the first time
senses.exampleEnglish: Opening the garden to visitors was a first for the family, who had always kept the property private.
senses.exampleChinese: 向游客开放花园是这家人首次尝试，此前他们一直不公开庄园。

phrases.english: at the beginning of a situation
phrases.exampleEnglish: The instructions seemed complicated at first, but the practical demonstration made every stage much easier to understand.
phrases.exampleChinese: 说明起初显得复杂，但实际演示让每阶段都容易理解。

senses.english: not old, recently born, built, or made
senses.exampleEnglish: The new walking route passes several small farms that visitors could not easily reach before the bridge opened.
senses.exampleChinese: 新步行路线经过几座小农场，桥开通前游客很难到达那里。

senses.english: not yet familiar to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The booking system was new to most volunteers, so the organiser demonstrated how to use it before opening.
senses.exampleChinese: 多数志愿者不熟悉预订系统，因此组织者开放前先演示用法。

senses.english: how something is done
senses.exampleEnglish: We need a better way to share information so that important messages do not get lost.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要更好的信息共享方法，以免重要消息遗漏。

senses.english: a route or direction to a place
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide showed us a quieter way to the station that avoided the busiest roads near the market.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游指给我们一条避开市场旁繁忙道路的安静车站路线。

senses.english: a distance to be travelled
senses.exampleEnglish: We still had a long way to walk when the rain started, so we stopped at a nearby café.
senses.exampleChinese: 下雨时还有很长路要走，因此我们在附近咖啡馆停下。

senses.english: an aspect or respect in which something is considered
senses.exampleEnglish: In many ways, the smaller workshop was more useful because everyone had more time to practise and ask questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 从很多方面说，小型工作坊更有用，因为人人有更多练习和提问时间。

phrases.english: blocking movement or making something difficult
phrases.exampleEnglish: The extra chairs were in the way, so we moved them upstairs before the first visitors entered the hall.
phrases.exampleChinese: 多余椅子挡路，因此首批游客进大厅前我们把它们搬上楼。

phrases.english: during a journey or about to happen
phrases.exampleEnglish: We stopped at the bakery on the way to the station because the children had not eaten breakfast.
phrases.exampleChinese: 去车站途中我们在面包店停下，因为孩子们没吃早饭。

senses.english: to discover something by looking for it
senses.exampleEnglish: After searching through several boxes, I finally managed to find the photographs my grandmother had mentioned.
senses.exampleChinese: 翻找几个箱子后，我终于找到了奶奶提过的照片。

senses.english: discover or judge a quality through experience
senses.exampleEnglish: We found the new instructions much easier to follow after the organiser added clear diagrams beside each step.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者在每步旁添上清晰示意图后，我们觉得新说明容易懂多了。

senses.english: something valuable or interesting that is discovered
senses.exampleEnglish: The old photograph was an important find because it showed how the bridge looked before the repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 老照片是重要发现，因为它展示了维修前桥的样子。

phrases.english: discover information or the truth
phrases.exampleEnglish: We need to find out when the museum closes before deciding how much time to spend in the garden.
phrases.exampleChinese: 决定花多少时间逛花园前，我们得查明博物馆何时闭馆。

senses.chinese: 在...上面；穿越；多于；在...另一边
senses.english: above; across; more than; on the other side
senses.exampleEnglish: We crossed over the wooden bridge slowly because some of the boards were slippery after the rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们慢慢走过木桥，因为雨后有些木板很滑。

senses.english: finished or ended
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop was over before we had finished discussing our ideas, so several people stayed for a coffee.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊结束时我们还没讨论完，因此几个人留下喝咖啡。

senses.english: more than a stated amount or number
senses.exampleEnglish: Over fifty volunteers helped repair the garden, making it possible to finish the main work before winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 五十多名志愿者帮助修花园，让主要工作能在入冬前完成。

senses.english: throughout a period of time
senses.exampleEnglish: We learned several practical skills over the weekend while helping our neighbours restore the old furniture upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 周末帮助邻居修楼上旧家具时，我们学了几项实用技能。

senses.english: again or from beginning to end
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor explained the final step over again because several people had missed the demonstration from the back.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练又讲了一次最后步骤，因为后排几个人没看到演示。

phrases.english: repeatedly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The guide did not mind explaining the instructions over and over because several visitors were learning the language.
phrases.exampleChinese: 导游不介意反复解释说明，因为有些游客正在学这门语言。

senses.english: one (thing) of many; some (thing)
senses.exampleEnglish: If you have any questions about the schedule, please speak to the organiser before the session begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果你对日程有任何疑问，请在活动开始前向组织者询问。

senses.english: any person, thing, or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: There were several spare chairs upstairs, but we did not need any because everyone had already found a seat.
senses.exampleChinese: 楼上有几把备用椅子，但大家都已坐下，我们一把也不需要。

senses.chinese: 丝毫；再多一点（用于比较）
senses.english: to any degree, especially in comparisons
senses.exampleEnglish: The new map was not any clearer, so we asked a local resident to explain the route.
senses.exampleChinese: 新地图并没更清楚，因此我们请当地居民解释路线。

senses.english: later than another time, or behind something
senses.exampleEnglish: We watched the children enter the museum, and their teacher followed shortly after with the tickets.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们看着孩子们走进博物馆，不久后老师拿着票跟了进去。

senses.english: following something in time or order
senses.exampleEnglish: We visited the garden after lunch because the guide said the morning exhibition would take longer than usual.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们午饭后参观花园，因为导游说上午展览会比平时久。

senses.english: following the time when something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: After the rain stopped, we carried the tables outside and prepared enough seats for all the visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 雨停后，我们把桌子搬到外面，给所有游客准备足够座位。

senses.english: trying to find or obtain something
senses.exampleEnglish: The customer was after a small table that could fit beside the window without blocking the doorway.
senses.exampleChinese: 顾客想找一张可放窗边又不挡门的小桌子。

senses.english: a period of 24 hours
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent a whole day exploring the island, stopping whenever we found a quiet beach or interesting village.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们花了一整天游览岛屿，每遇到安静的海滩或有趣的村子就停下来。

senses.english: the hours when there is natural daylight
senses.exampleEnglish: During the day, the workshop receives enough natural light, but evening classes need several extra lamps.
senses.exampleChinese: 白天工作间自然光充足，但晚课需要几盏额外灯。

senses.english: word you use to ask the location of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained where we should wait if the group became separated during the busy festival.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游说明了，如果节日期间人多导致队伍走散，我们应该在哪里等候。

senses.english: introduces information about a place
senses.exampleEnglish: The village where my grandparents lived has changed considerably since the railway station reopened and attracted more visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 祖父母住过的村子自火车站重开并吸引游客后，变化很大。

senses.english: something you cannot remember the name of
senses.exampleEnglish: I cannot remember the name of the small thing that keeps the cupboard door firmly closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我记不起来那个能把橱柜门扣紧的小东西叫什么。

senses.english: nearly all of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Most of the volunteers had never met before, but they quickly learned how to work together.
senses.exampleChinese: 大多数志愿者以前从未见过，却很快学会了如何合作。

senses.english: the majority or largest amount
