senses.exampleEnglish: Most visitors choose the shorter tour because it leaves enough time to explore the garden before lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 多数游客选择较短导览，因为午饭前还能有时间逛花园。

senses.english: forms the highest degree of a quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The most useful part of the workshop was the demonstration, which showed us how to avoid several common mistakes.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊最有用的是演示，它教我们避免几种常见错误。

senses.english: used to indicate what is proper or reasonable
senses.exampleEnglish: You should keep a copy of the receipt in case you need to return the product later.
senses.exampleChinese: 你应该保存一份收据，以防之后需要退货。

senses.english: expresses an expected or likely result
senses.exampleEnglish: The parcel should arrive before Friday, although the shop warned that bad weather could delay some deliveries.
senses.exampleChinese: 包裹按理周五前到，但商店提醒恶劣天气可能导致延误。

senses.english: to be unable to manage without something; require
senses.exampleEnglish: We need a larger room for the workshop because more people have registered than we originally expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊需要更大的房间，因为报名人数超出了最初预期。

senses.english: something necessary or the state of requiring it
senses.exampleEnglish: The new bus service meets a real need for residents who cannot easily travel into town by car.
senses.exampleChinese: 新公交满足了难以开车进城的居民的实际需求。

senses.chinese: 有必要（常用于否定或疑问）
senses.english: expresses necessity, mainly in negatives and questions
senses.exampleEnglish: You need not bring any tools because the organisers provide everything required for the practical part of the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 你不必带工具，因为组织者提供实践部分所需的一切。

phrases.english: requiring help or something necessary
phrases.exampleEnglish: The old chairs are in need of repair, although their wooden frames are still strong enough to use.
phrases.exampleChinese: 旧椅子需要修理，不过木框仍够结实可用。

senses.english: a lot; large amount; a high degree of
senses.exampleEnglish: Much of what we learned during the workshop can be used immediately in our everyday work.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在工作坊学到的许多东西，都能立刻用于日常工作。

senses.chinese: 许多；大量（用于不可数名词）
senses.english: a large amount of something uncountable
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not have much time to explore the village before the bus returned to collect our group.
senses.exampleChinese: 公交返回接我们之前，我们没有多少时间游览村庄。

senses.english: to a great degree
senses.exampleEnglish: The new chairs are much more comfortable, especially for visitors who need to sit through the whole presentation.
senses.exampleChinese: 新椅子舒服得多，尤其适合需要坐着听完整场讲解的游客。

senses.english: on side where the hand that most people write with
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep your bag in your right hand while you use the other hand to hold the rail.
senses.exampleChinese: 用右手提着包，同时用另一只手扶住栏杆。

senses.english: correct, suitable, or morally acceptable
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked that we had the right address before carrying the heavy boxes into the building beside the library.
senses.exampleChinese: 把重箱搬进图书馆旁建筑前，我们核对了地址正确。

senses.english: a moral or legal entitlement
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents have a right to ask questions before the council decides how the public garden will be changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 市政会决定如何改造公共花园前，居民有权提问。

senses.english: exactly or directly
senses.exampleEnglish: The small café is right beside the station, so we can wait there without worrying about missing the train.
senses.exampleChinese: 小咖啡馆就在车站旁，所以我们可以在那里等而不怕误车。

senses.english: the political groups supporting conservative policies
senses.exampleEnglish: The debate included speakers from the right and the left, allowing residents to hear several different views.
senses.exampleChinese: 辩论邀请了右翼和左翼讲者，让居民听到不同观点。

phrases.english: immediately
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please tell the organiser right away if the equipment stops working so that someone can check it safely.
phrases.exampleChinese: 设备停机时请立刻告诉组织者，让人安全检查。

senses.english: in what way something happens or is done
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor explained how we could adjust the camera settings to take clearer photographs in poor light.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练讲解了如何调整相机设置，以便在光线差时拍出更清晰的照片。

senses.english: behind; to the rear; previous
senses.exampleEnglish: We used the back entrance because a delivery van was blocking the main door of the shop.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们走了后门，因为一辆送货车挡住了商店正门。

senses.english: the rear part of a body or object
senses.exampleEnglish: The heavy bag hurt my back, so we stopped beside the bridge and shared the supplies more evenly.
senses.exampleChinese: 重包让我背疼，因此我们在桥边停下，把物资分配得更均匀。

senses.english: to an earlier place or condition
senses.exampleEnglish: We went back to the museum after lunch because several rooms had been closed during our morning visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 午饭后我们返回博物馆，因为上午参观时几间房没开。

senses.english: in a direction behind someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please stand back while the volunteers carry the large wooden frame through the narrow doorway into the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者把大木框从窄门搬进大厅时，请退后。

senses.english: support a person, plan, or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: Several local businesses agreed to back the project because the new garden would benefit residents throughout the neighbourhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 几家当地企业同意支持项目，因为新花园有益整个社区的居民。

phrases.english: without someone's knowledge, often unfairly
phrases.exampleEnglish: They changed the timetable behind our backs, which caused confusion when we arrived for the usual afternoon session.
phrases.exampleChinese: 他们背着我们改了时间表，我们按平日下午时间到场后很困惑。

senses.english: to have a particular meaning or value
senses.exampleEnglish: The coloured lines mean different things, so check the guide before you begin following the route.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些彩色线条含义不同，所以沿路线走之前先查看指南。

senses.english: intend or have as a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: I did not mean to interrupt the demonstration, but I thought the equipment had suddenly stopped working.
senses.exampleChinese: 我无意打断演示，只是以为设备突然停了。

senses.chinese: 意味着必须做；必然带来
senses.english: involve or make something necessary
senses.exampleEnglish: Choosing the coastal route will mean leaving earlier, but we should have enough time to enjoy the views.
senses.exampleChinese: 选沿海路线意味着要早出发，但应能留足时间欣赏风景。

senses.english: unkind or unwilling to be generous
senses.exampleEnglish: It seemed mean to exclude the younger children when they had helped prepare the whole community event.
senses.exampleChinese: 小孩子帮忙筹备了整个社区活动，却不让他们参加，显得很刻薄。

senses.english: the total divided by the number of values
senses.exampleEnglish: We calculated the mean of our journey times before deciding how long future visitors should allow for the walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们计算了几次步行时间的平均值，再建议后续游客预留多久。

senses.english: as well; too
senses.exampleEnglish: The basic ticket includes the gardens and even gives visitors access to the newly restored tower.
senses.exampleChinese: 基础门票包含花园，甚至还允许游客进入新修复的塔楼。

senses.english: flat, level, or evenly distributed
senses.exampleEnglish: We need an even surface for the model railway so that the small carriages do not roll away unexpectedly.
senses.exampleChinese: 模型铁路需要平整表面，避免小车厢意外滑走。

senses.english: equal in amount, score, or ability
senses.exampleEnglish: The teams were evenly matched, and the score remained even until the final few minutes of the game.
senses.exampleChinese: 两队实力相当，直到最后几分钟比分仍持平。

senses.english: divisible by two without a remainder
senses.exampleEnglish: We need an even number of participants so that everyone can work with a partner during the final activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要偶数位参与者，让最后活动中人人都有搭档。

phrases.english: earn as much as the costs
phrases.exampleEnglish: The small café needs enough weekend visitors to break even before it can afford to extend its opening hours.
phrases.exampleChinese: 小咖啡馆需要足够周末顾客先实现收支平衡，才能延长营业时间。

senses.english: used to talk about what is possible
senses.exampleEnglish: The outdoor concert may finish earlier than planned if the temperature drops sharply after the sun goes down.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果日落后气温骤降，户外音乐会可能会提前结束。

senses.english: be allowed to do something, often formally
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors may use the garden tables after the tour, provided that they leave the area clean and tidy.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客可在导览后用花园桌子，但须保持干净整洁。

senses.english: the fifth month of the year
senses.exampleEnglish: The garden usually opens in May, when the warmer weather encourages more visitors to explore the surrounding countryside.
senses.exampleChinese: 花园通常五月开放，天气变暖吸引更多游客探索周边乡村。

senses.english: in, at, or to this position or place
senses.exampleEnglish: Please leave your bicycle here while you collect your ticket from the office across the road.
senses.exampleChinese: 你去马路对面的办公室取票时，请把自行车留在这里。

senses.english: used to refer to a large number of things
senses.exampleEnglish: Many local shops stayed open late because the festival attracted visitors from all over the region.
senses.exampleChinese: 许多当地商店营业到很晚，因为节日吸引了整个地区的游客。

senses.english: a large number of people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: Many of the volunteers had never met before, but they quickly learned to share tools and divide the work.
senses.exampleChinese: 许多志愿者之前互不认识，却很快学会共享工具、分配工作。

senses.english: so like, or similar
senses.exampleEnglish: We had never seen such clear water before, so we spent the whole afternoon beside the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们从没见过如此清澈的水，于是在湖边待了整个下午。

senses.english: the most recent; coming after all others
senses.exampleEnglish: The last bus leaves before the exhibition closes, so we will need to arrange another way home.
senses.exampleChinese: 末班车在展览闭馆前发车，因此我们得另想办法回家。

senses.english: most recent or immediately previous
senses.exampleEnglish: Our last visit was during the winter, when several rooms were closed because the heating needed urgent repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们上次冬天来时，几间房因暖气急需维修而关闭。

senses.english: continue for a period or remain sufficient
senses.exampleEnglish: The demonstration will last about an hour, leaving enough time for everyone to practise before the workshop finishes.
senses.exampleChinese: 演示大约持续一小时，让大家在工作坊结束前有时间练习。

senses.english: after all others or on the most recent occasion
senses.exampleEnglish: We last saw the guide at the station, where she was helping visitors find the correct platform.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们最后在车站见到导游，当时她正在帮游客找站台。

senses.english: a very young person, between about 2 and 15
senses.exampleEnglish: Every child who joins the activity must bring a warm coat, even if the morning seems sunny.
senses.exampleChinese: 参加活动的每个孩子都必须带厚外套，即使早上看起来天气晴朗。

senses.english: a son or daughter of any age
senses.exampleEnglish: Their youngest child now works abroad, but she returns every summer to help them repair the family home.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们最小的孩子如今在国外工作，但每夏都回来帮修祖宅。

senses.english: to say or communicate information to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Please tell the receptionist if you need a quieter room, as several alternatives are still available upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果你需要更安静的房间，请告诉接待员，楼上还有几个可选房间。

senses.english: recognise a difference or reach a conclusion from evidence
senses.exampleEnglish: We could not tell which photograph was older until the guide explained the changes to the building in the background.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释背景建筑的变化后，我们才分辨出哪张照片更早。

senses.english: instruct someone to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser told us to leave the equipment upstairs so that the next group could begin without delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者吩咐我们把设备留楼上，让下一组能及时开始。

phrases.english: speak angrily to someone for doing something wrong
phrases.exampleEnglish: The organiser did not want to tell off the children before explaining why the equipment needed careful handling.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者不想先训孩子，而是先解释设备为何须小心操作。

senses.english: very
senses.exampleEnglish: The new cycle path is really useful because it connects our neighbourhood directly to the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 新自行车道非常实用，因为它把我们的社区直接连到了车站。

senses.english: actually or genuinely, rather than only apparently
senses.exampleEnglish: The bridge really was older than the village, as the newly discovered records showed when the historian examined them.
senses.exampleChinese: 历史学家检查新发现档案后确认，桥确实比村子更早。

senses.english: to phone someone
senses.exampleEnglish: I will call the shop tomorrow morning to check whether the replacement part has finally arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 我明早会给商店打电话，确认替换零件是否终于到货。

senses.english: give a name or describe someone in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: The children called their model boat Explorer because they hoped it would travel across the whole pond.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们把模型船取名为探索者，希望它能驶过整片池塘。

senses.english: shout or ask someone to come
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide called to the visitors waiting outside, asking them to come closer so that everyone could hear.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游向外面等候的游客喊话，请他们靠近，好让人人听见。

senses.english: an act of speaking by telephone
senses.exampleEnglish: We received a call from the hotel explaining that our room would be ready earlier than originally expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店来电说明，我们的房间将比原先预计更早准备好。

senses.english: a public request or demand for action
senses.exampleEnglish: The call for volunteers attracted residents who had never joined any of the neighbourhood's previous practical projects.
senses.exampleChinese: 招募志愿者的呼吁吸引了从未参与社区以往实践项目的居民。

phrases.english: cancel a planned event
phrases.exampleEnglish: We may have to call off the outdoor workshop if the forecast for heavy rain remains unchanged tomorrow.
phrases.exampleChinese: 若明天大雨预报不变，我们可能得取消户外工作坊。

phrases.english: telephone again or return later
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please call back after lunch when the manager has checked whether the smaller room is available for your group.
phrases.exampleChinese: 请午饭后再来电，到时经理已查小房间能否供你们使用。

senses.english: at a time earlier than the present; previously
senses.exampleEnglish: We had visited the village before, but we had never explored the forest beyond the old mill.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们以前到过这个村子，却从未探索过老磨坊外的森林。

senses.english: earlier than a time, event, or person
senses.exampleEnglish: We should check the final numbers before Friday so that the café knows how much food to prepare.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应周五前核对最终人数，让咖啡馆知道备多少食物。

senses.english: earlier than the time when something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: Please read the instructions before you open the box, because several small parts could easily be lost.
senses.exampleChinese: 开箱前请读说明，因为几个小零件很容易弄丢。

senses.english: in front of or in the presence of
senses.exampleEnglish: The students presented their designs before a small audience that included local artists and several experienced volunteers.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们向包括当地艺术家和资深志愿者的小型观众展示设计。

senses.english: a business that sells things or provides services
senses.exampleEnglish: The company offers flexible working hours, allowing employees to avoid the busiest trains during the morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家公司提供弹性工作时间，让员工能避开早上最拥挤的火车。

senses.english: the presence of someone to spend time with
senses.exampleEnglish: She enjoyed the company of her neighbours while they repaired the old chairs and exchanged stories about the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 她和邻居修旧椅子、聊村庄故事，享受有人相伴的时光。

senses.english: a group of actors or other performers
senses.exampleEnglish: A local theatre company will perform in the garden if the weather allows the temporary stage to remain outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 若天气允许临时舞台留在外面，当地剧团将在花园演出。

senses.english: from one end or side of something to the other end or side
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed the path through the forest until we reached a clearing beside a narrow stream.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们沿着穿过森林的小路前进，最后到达一条小溪旁的空地。

senses.english: during a whole period
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers worked through the afternoon so that the hall would be ready before the evening visitors arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者整个下午都在忙，让大厅赶在夜间游客来前准备好。

senses.english: by means of a person, process, or experience
senses.exampleEnglish: We learned about the project through a neighbour who had helped restore several buildings in the same area.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们通过邻居了解到项目，他曾帮修同地区几栋建筑。

senses.english: finished with a task or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: Once we were through with the measurements, we could begin cutting the wood for the new shelves upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 量完尺寸后，我们就能开始切楼上新架子用的木料。

senses.english: going from a higher position to a lower position
senses.exampleEnglish: The children walked down the steep steps carefully because the stone surface was wet from rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们小心地走下陡峭台阶，因为石面被雨水打湿了。

senses.english: towards a lower amount or level
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisers brought the price down so that more families could afford to attend the practical afternoon workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者降低价格，让更多家庭负担得起下午实践工作坊。

senses.english: unhappy or discouraged
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt down after the first design failed, but encouragement from the group helped her try again.
senses.exampleChinese: 首个设计失败后她情绪低落，但组员鼓励让她再次尝试。

senses.chinese: 系统停机的；无法运行的
senses.english: not working, especially for a computer system
senses.exampleEnglish: The booking system was down all morning, so staff wrote reservations on paper until the problem was fixed.
senses.exampleChinese: 预订系统整个上午停机，修好前员工用纸记录预订。

senses.english: soft feathers used for warmth
senses.exampleEnglish: The jacket contains recycled down, making it warm enough for walking even when the coastal wind becomes cold.
senses.exampleChinese: 夹克填充再生羽绒，即使海风变冷也足够暖和。

senses.english: to explain or teach how something is done
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you show the new volunteers how to use the equipment before the first visitors arrive?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能在首批游客到来前，教新志愿者如何使用这些设备吗？

senses.english: display something or make it visible
senses.exampleEnglish: Please show your ticket to the person at the door before entering the smaller exhibition room upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 进入楼上小展厅前，请向门口工作人员出示票。

senses.english: provide evidence or make something clear
senses.exampleEnglish: The new photographs show that the bridge had already been repaired before the railway station opened nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 新照片表明，附近火车站开通前桥就已修好。

senses.english: lead someone to a place
senses.exampleEnglish: A volunteer will show you to the meeting room once the previous group has finished clearing its materials away.
senses.exampleChinese: 前组收好材料后，志愿者会带你到会议室。

senses.english: a performance, programme, or public exhibition
senses.exampleEnglish: The evening show combines live music with stories about the families who once lived along the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 晚间演出结合现场音乐，讲述曾在河边生活的家庭故事。

senses.english: all the living things (e.g., animals, plants, humans)
senses.exampleEnglish: The discovery of plant life in the tiny pond encouraged the children to study its surroundings more carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 小池塘里发现植物生命，促使孩子们更仔细地研究周围环境。

senses.english: the period when someone or something is alive
senses.exampleEnglish: She spent most of her life in the village, collecting photographs that later became part of the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 她大半生住村里，收集的照片后来成为博物馆藏品。

senses.chinese: 生活；生活方式；生活状况
senses.english: the way someone lives and their experiences
senses.exampleEnglish: Life in the village became easier after the new bus route connected residents to the town's shops and services.
senses.exampleChinese: 新公交把居民与镇上商店服务连接后，村里生活更方便。

senses.english: energy or lively activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The new community garden brought life back to the square, which had been quiet for several years.
senses.exampleChinese: 新社区花园给沉寂数年的广场重新带来活力。

senses.english: an adult male human being
senses.exampleEnglish: A man waiting outside the station offered to help when he saw us struggling with our suitcases.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位在车站外等候的男子看到我们费力地搬行李，主动提出帮忙。

senses.english: work at or provide staff for a place
senses.exampleEnglish: Two volunteers will man the information desk while the rest of us prepare the rooms for afternoon visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 两位志愿者值守咨询台，其余人布置房间迎接下午游客。

senses.english: to make or become different, or into something else
senses.exampleEnglish: We may need to change our plans if the museum remains closed throughout the school holidays.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果博物馆在整个学校假期都闭馆，我们可能需要改变计划。

senses.english: replace one thing with another
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to change trains at the next station because this service does not continue to the coastal villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们须在下一站换车，因为本班不继续开往沿海村庄。

senses.english: an alteration or a new situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The change to the timetable made it easier for parents to attend without leaving work earlier than usual.
senses.exampleChinese: 时间表的改变让家长不用比平常早下班就能参加。

senses.english: coins or money returned after payment
senses.exampleEnglish: Please bring some change for the car park because its old machine does not accept cards or large notes.
senses.exampleChinese: 请带零钱付停车费，因为旧机器不收卡或大钞。

phrases.english: decide differently from an earlier decision
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can change your mind about the route before Friday, but the guide needs final numbers by then.
phrases.exampleChinese: 周五前你可改路线主意，但导游到时需最终人数。

senses.english: to put something in a certain location or position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please place the completed forms in the blue tray so that staff can collect them later.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把填好的表格放进蓝色托盘，方便工作人员稍后收取。

senses.english: a particular location or area
senses.exampleEnglish: We found a quiet place beside the river where the children could eat lunch away from the crowded square.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在河边找了安静地方，让孩子远离拥挤广场吃午饭。

senses.english: a position, rank, or correct location
senses.exampleEnglish: The students put every tool back in its place before leaving the room for the next group.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们离开前把每件工具归位，让房间留给下一组。

senses.chinese: 名额；预订的座位或机会
senses.english: an opportunity or reserved space in an activity
senses.exampleEnglish: There are still a few places on the workshop, but you should book before the end of the week.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊还剩几个名额，但你应本周结束前预订。

phrases.english: happen or be held
phrases.exampleEnglish: The workshop will take place in the garden if the weather stays dry throughout the afternoon session.
phrases.exampleChinese: 若下午持续不下雨，工作坊将在花园举行。

phrases.english: instead of someone or something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We used recycled cardboard in place of new wood so that the children could test their designs cheaply.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们用回收纸板代替新木料，让孩子便宜地测试设计。

senses.english: large distance from one end to the other
senses.exampleEnglish: A long wooden bridge connects the island to the shore, allowing visitors to cross on foot.
senses.exampleChinese: 一座很长的木桥把岛屿和岸边连起来，游客可以步行通过。

senses.english: lasting a considerable amount of time
senses.exampleEnglish: After a long discussion, the group agreed to test the smaller design before spending money on more materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 长时间讨论后，小组决定先试小设计，再花钱买更多材料。

senses.english: for or after a considerable period
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not wait long before the guide returned with a map showing the safer route through the hills.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们没等多久，导游就拿回标着更安全山区路线的地图。

senses.english: want something very much
senses.exampleEnglish: After several busy weeks preparing the exhibition, we long for a quiet afternoon walking beside the sea.
senses.exampleChinese: 忙着筹展几周后，我们渴望安静地在海边散步一下午。

phrases.english: provided that a condition is satisfied
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can borrow the tools as long as you return them before the next group arrives on Friday.
phrases.exampleChinese: 只要周五下一组来前归还，你就能借工具。

phrases.english: not any more
phrases.exampleEnglish: The old bridge is no longer open to cars, although visitors can still cross it safely on foot.
phrases.exampleChinese: 旧桥不再通汽车，但游客仍可安全步行过桥。

senses.english: in the space that separates two objects
senses.exampleEnglish: The little café stands between the library and the station, making it a convenient meeting place.
senses.exampleChinese: 小咖啡馆位于图书馆和车站之间，是一个方便的会面地点。

senses.chinese: 在两个时间或数量之间
senses.english: in an interval separating two points
senses.exampleEnglish: The hall is free between two and four, which should give us enough time to prepare the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 大厅两点到四点空着，应足够我们布置展览。

senses.english: connects people, choices, or relationships
senses.exampleEnglish: The project improved communication between residents and local businesses by giving them a practical goal to work towards together.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目给居民和当地企业一个共同实践目标，改善了双方沟通。

senses.english: to be aware of or experience an emotion or sensation
senses.exampleEnglish: I feel much more confident about speaking English now that I practise with a partner every week.
senses.exampleChinese: 现在我每周都和搭档练习，对说英语自信多了。

senses.english: use touch to examine or find something
senses.exampleEnglish: Feel the surface carefully before painting it so that you can notice any rough areas that need smoothing.
senses.exampleChinese: 上漆前仔细摸表面，找出需要磨平的粗糙处。

senses.english: have an opinion or belief
senses.exampleEnglish: We feel that the smaller venue would suit the workshop better because everyone could hear the instructor clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们觉得小场地更合适，因为人人能听清教练。

senses.english: a sensation, texture, or general impression
senses.exampleEnglish: The new lighting gave the room a warmer feel without changing the old wooden furniture that visitors enjoyed.
senses.exampleChinese: 新照明让房间更温馨，同时保留游客喜欢的老木家具。

phrases.english: want to do something or have the impression of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: If you feel like staying longer, the café will remain open after the main exhibition closes this evening.
phrases.exampleChinese: 若你想多留一会，今晚主展闭馆后咖啡馆仍开放。

senses.english: say that something is more than you want
senses.exampleEnglish: The room was too crowded for a practical workshop, so the organiser moved us into the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间太挤，无法开展实践工作坊，因此组织者让我们移到了大厅。

senses.english: also or in addition
senses.exampleEnglish: My brother joined the repair workshop too, although he had originally planned to spend the afternoon at the library.
senses.exampleChinese: 哥哥也参加维修工作坊，虽原打算下午在图书馆过。

senses.english: happening in the past and continuing into the present
senses.exampleEnglish: We still use the wooden table my grandfather made, although its surface has become slightly uneven.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们仍在用爷爷做的木桌，虽然桌面已经有些不平了。

senses.english: not moving or making a disturbance
senses.exampleEnglish: The lake was completely still when we arrived, allowing us to photograph clear reflections of the hills above it.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到时湖面完全平静，能拍清上方山丘倒影。

senses.english: nevertheless or despite what was just said
senses.exampleEnglish: The route was longer than expected; still, the quiet villages made the extra walking feel worthwhile for everyone.
senses.exampleChinese: 路线比预期长，不过安静村庄让大家觉得多走也值得。

senses.english: something difficult to deal with or causes trouble
senses.exampleEnglish: The main problem was the lack of storage space, which made the small kitchen difficult to organise.
senses.exampleChinese: 主要问题是缺少储物空间，这让小厨房很难整理。

senses.english: a question or task requiring a solution
senses.exampleEnglish: The students worked together on a mathematical problem that involved planning the most efficient route between several villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们合作解一道数学题，涉及规划几个村庄间最有效路线。

senses.english: to make letters and words on paper or a screen
senses.exampleEnglish: Please write your contact details clearly so that the organiser can reach you if the schedule changes.
senses.exampleChinese: 请清楚填写联系方式，方便组织者在日程变动时联系你。

senses.english: compose text or a piece of music
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will write a short guide explaining how visitors can explore the garden without damaging its oldest plants.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者将写简短指南，说明怎样游园而不损坏最老植物。

senses.english: record computer data on a storage device
senses.exampleEnglish: The computer will write a backup copy before closing, so we can recover the booking details if necessary.
senses.exampleChinese: 电脑关闭前会写入备份，必要时可恢复预订详情。

phrases.english: record something in writing
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please write down any questions during the demonstration so that the instructor can discuss them after everyone has practised.
phrases.exampleChinese: 演示时请记下问题，等大家练习后教练再讨论。

senses.english: identical; not different
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose the same hotel as last year because its location had made exploring the city easy.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选了去年的同一家酒店，因为它的位置方便游览城市。

senses.chinese: 相同的人或物；同样情况
senses.english: the identical thing or an unchanged situation
senses.exampleEnglish: We asked for a different room, but the receptionist said the same was true of every available space upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们要求换房，但接待员说楼上每个空房都一样。

senses.english: A large quantity, or number taken together
senses.exampleEnglish: We learned a lot from the first attempt, even though the model did not work as expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然模型没有按预期运作，但第一次尝试让我们学到了很多。

senses.english: an area of land used for a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The empty lot beside the station became a community garden after residents raised enough money to rent it.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民筹够租金后，车站旁空地成了社区花园。

senses.english: very good; fantastic; wonderful
senses.exampleEnglish: The community garden has been a great success, bringing together neighbours who rarely spoke to each other before.
senses.exampleChinese: 社区花园取得了巨大成功，让以前很少交谈的邻居们聚在一起。

senses.english: large in amount, size, or degree
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide took great care with the photographs because several were the only copies known to exist.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游十分小心保管照片，因为几张是仅存已知副本。

senses.english: highly important, talented, or admired
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explores the work of great designers whose simple ideas changed the way people use everyday objects.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览研究杰出设计师作品，他们的简单想法改变了日常物品用法。

senses.english: to make an effort, to attempt to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: We should try a different route tomorrow because the coastal road is likely to be very busy.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们明天应该尝试别的路线，因为沿海道路可能会很拥堵。

senses.chinese: 试用；尝试某种方法或体验
senses.english: test something to discover its effect or suitability
senses.exampleEnglish: We should try the new tools on spare wood before using them to repair the valuable old table.
senses.exampleChinese: 应先在废木料上试新工具，再修珍贵老桌。

senses.english: an attempt to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Our first try was unsuccessful, but the instructor helped us see which small changes would improve the design.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一次尝试失败，但教练帮助我们看出哪些小改动可改善设计。

senses.english: examine a case in a court of law
senses.exampleEnglish: The court will try the case next month after both sides have had enough time to prepare their evidence.
senses.exampleChinese: 双方有足够时间准备证据后，法院将下月审理案件。

phrases.english: put on clothing to check its fit
phrases.exampleEnglish: You should try on the jacket before buying it because different brands can use rather different measurements.
phrases.exampleChinese: 买夹克前应试穿，因为不同品牌尺码可能差异大。

senses.english: to go away from; depart
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to leave the campsite early so that we could reach the village before the storm.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定提早离开营地，以便在暴风雨前赶到村子。

senses.english: allow something to remain in a place or condition
senses.exampleEnglish: Please leave the windows open after the workshop so that the room can cool before the next group arrives.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊后请让窗开着，好在下一组来前降温。

senses.english: give something to someone after death
senses.exampleEnglish: Her aunt left the old house to the family, along with several boxes of photographs from the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 阿姨把老房子留给这家人，还有几箱村庄照片。

senses.english: authorised time away from work
senses.exampleEnglish: She took a week's leave to help her parents move, arranging for a colleague to answer urgent messages.
senses.exampleChinese: 她请一周假帮父母搬家，安排同事回复急件。

phrases.english: omit or fail to include something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please do not leave out the safety instructions when you shorten the leaflet for visitors with limited reading time.
phrases.exampleChinese: 缩短传单供阅读时间有限游客使用时，请别删安全说明。

senses.english: symbols such as 1, 2, 56, 793
senses.exampleEnglish: Write the reference number on the envelope so that staff can match your documents to the correct application.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在信封上写明参考编号，方便工作人员把文件匹配到正确的申请。

senses.english: how many people or things there are
senses.exampleEnglish: The number of visitors increased after the new bus service made the village easier to reach from town.
senses.exampleChinese: 新公交让镇上进村更方便后，游客人数增加。

senses.english: label with numbers or amount to a total
senses.exampleEnglish: Please number the boxes before loading them so that the volunteers know which room each one belongs in.
senses.exampleChinese: 装车前请给箱子编号，让志愿者知道各箱属于哪个房间。

senses.english: used to refer to two things at the same time
senses.exampleEnglish: Both routes offer beautiful views, but the one along the coast is easier for inexperienced walkers.
senses.exampleChinese: 两条路线景色都很美，但沿海那条更适合没有经验的徒步者。

senses.english: the two people or things together
senses.exampleEnglish: The two routes looked interesting, but both involved more climbing than the younger children were ready to attempt.
senses.exampleChinese: 两条路线都有趣，但都需要超出小孩子能力的爬坡。

senses.english: yours, his, hers, etc.; not belonging to another
senses.exampleEnglish: We prepared our own lunch instead of buying food, which helped us keep the trip affordable.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们自备午饭而没有买吃的，这有助于控制旅行费用。

senses.english: have something as your property
senses.exampleEnglish: The family still own the old bakery, although they now rent the upstairs rooms to visitors in summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人仍拥有老面包店，虽现把楼上房间夏季租给游客。

phrases.english: alone or without help
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can complete the simple repairs on your own once the instructor has shown you how the tools work.
phrases.exampleChinese: 教练教会工具用法后，你可独自完成简单维修。

senses.english: some, but not all of a specific thing
senses.exampleEnglish: We repaired the damaged part of the fence before the animals were allowed back into the field.
senses.exampleChinese: 动物们获准回到田里前，我们修好了围栏受损的部分。

senses.english: a role or contribution in an activity
senses.exampleEnglish: Every volunteer had a part in preparing the exhibition, from collecting photographs to welcoming visitors at the door.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位志愿者都参与筹展，从收集照片到门口迎客。

senses.english: separate or leave someone
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to part at the station because my friend was travelling north while I was returning home.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在车站分开，因为朋友北上而我回家。

phrases.english: participate in an activity
phrases.exampleEnglish: Residents can take part in the planting project even if they have only a little time available at weekends.
phrases.exampleChinese: 居民即使周末只有少量空闲，也能参加种植项目。

senses.english: to indicate something with your finger to others
senses.exampleEnglish: Please point to the symbol on the map so that everyone understands which entrance we should use.
senses.exampleChinese: 请指一下地图上的符号，让大家都明白该使用哪个入口。

senses.english: an idea or important detail in a discussion
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker made an interesting point about how simple repairs can reduce waste and save families money.
senses.exampleChinese: 讲者提出有趣观点：简单维修可减少浪费并帮家庭省钱。

senses.english: the sharp or narrow end of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The point of the pencil broke while I was marking the wood, so I borrowed another one.
senses.exampleChinese: 我在木料上标记时笔尖断了，因此借了另一支。

senses.english: a unit used in a score or scale
senses.exampleEnglish: The team needed one more point to win, but the final question was harder than anyone had expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 队伍再得一分就赢，但最后问题超出大家预期地难。

senses.english: a particular moment, place, or stage
senses.exampleEnglish: At that point, the guide realised we would miss the last bus unless we took the shorter route.
senses.exampleChinese: 那时导游意识到，若不走捷径就会误末班车。

senses.english: a purpose or reason for doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: There is little point in buying more materials until we know which parts of the design actually need changing.
senses.exampleChinese: 还不知道设计哪些部分要改时，多买材料没多少意义。

senses.english: face or direct something towards a place
senses.exampleEnglish: The arrow should point towards the side entrance so that visitors do not walk into the delivery area.
senses.exampleChinese: 箭头应朝侧门，让游客不误入收货区。

senses.english: not great in size, amount, or degree; small
senses.exampleEnglish: The little house beside the bridge has been carefully restored and now welcomes visitors during summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 桥边的小房子经过精心修复，现在夏季会接待游客。

senses.chinese: 很少；几乎没有（不可数名词）
senses.english: a small amount, often less than needed
senses.exampleEnglish: We had little time to explore the garden because the morning demonstration lasted much longer than the organiser expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 上午演示超出组织者预期，留给游园时间很少。

senses.english: a small amount of something
senses.exampleEnglish: There was very little left after the picnic, so cleaning the tables took less time than usual.
senses.exampleChinese: 野餐后几乎没剩东西，因此清桌比平时快。

senses.english: not much or hardly at all
senses.exampleEnglish: The village has changed little since our last visit, although the old station now contains a busy café.
senses.exampleChinese: 自上次来村里变化很小，不过老车站现有家热闹咖啡馆。

senses.english: to act to enable a person to do something; assist
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide offered to help us choose a walking route that would suit everyone in our group.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游主动帮助我们选择一条适合队里所有人的徒步路线。

senses.english: assistance or something useful
senses.exampleEnglish: We could not have finished the repairs without help from neighbours who understood how the old mechanism worked.
senses.exampleChinese: 没有熟悉旧机芯的邻居帮忙，我们无法完成维修。

phrases.english: be unable to stop a reaction or feeling
phrases.exampleEnglish: We cannot help feeling disappointed when a project fails, but discussing the mistakes can make the next attempt better.
phrases.exampleChinese: 项目失败难免失望，但讨论错误可改善下次尝试。

senses.english: to say to someone that you want something
senses.exampleEnglish: You should ask a member of staff for permission before taking photographs inside the main exhibition hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 在主展厅内拍照前，你应该先向工作人员请求许可。

senses.english: put a question to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide asked whether anyone had visited before, so she could choose the most useful details to explain.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游问谁以前来过，以便选择最有用的细节讲解。

senses.english: invite someone to do something or attend
senses.exampleEnglish: We asked our neighbours to join us for dinner after they had spent the afternoon helping repair the fence.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居帮修篱笆一下午后，我们邀请他们共进晚餐。

senses.english: request a price or payment
senses.exampleEnglish: The owner was asking more than we could afford, so we looked for a smaller table in another shop.
senses.exampleChinese: 店主要价超预算，因此我们去另一店找小桌。

senses.english: to come together at a certain time or place
senses.exampleEnglish: We arranged to meet outside the library because everyone could reach it easily by public transport.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们约好在图书馆外见面，因为大家坐公共交通都能方便到达。

senses.english: encounter someone for the first time
senses.exampleEnglish: We will meet the new volunteers before the activity begins so that everyone knows who needs extra support.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们会活动前认识新志愿者，让大家知道谁需额外支持。

collocations.english: meet someone for the first time

senses.english: satisfy a need, rule, or standard
senses.exampleEnglish: The design must meet the safety requirements before visitors are allowed to try the model during the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 设计必须达安全要求，游客才可在展览中试模型。

senses.english: first time or place that a thing exists; beginning
senses.exampleEnglish: The start of the walking tour was delayed because several visitors had difficulty finding the meeting point.
senses.exampleChinese: 徒步导览推迟开始，因为几位游客找不到集合地点。

senses.english: begin an activity or make something operate
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot start the machine until the instructor checks that everyone knows where to stand during the demonstration.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练确认人人知道演示时站哪，才可启动机器。

senses.english: a sudden movement caused by surprise
senses.exampleEnglish: She woke with a start when the old clock rang, although the room had been quiet moments earlier.
senses.exampleChinese: 老钟一响，她惊醒了，片刻前房间还很安静。

senses.english: to say things or ideas to someone with words
senses.exampleEnglish: We should talk about the problem calmly before deciding whether the original plan needs to be changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该先冷静讨论问题，再决定是否需要更改原计划。

senses.english: a conversation, speech, or discussion
senses.exampleEnglish: The short talk helped us understand the building's history before we began exploring the smaller rooms upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 简短讲解帮我们了解建筑历史，再探索楼上小房间。

phrases.english: persuade someone to do something
phrases.exampleEnglish: You should not talk someone into joining the longer walk if they are worried about the steep paths.
phrases.exampleChinese: 若有人担心陡路，就不该说服他们参加长路线。

senses.english: thing that is not yet known or named
senses.exampleEnglish: I need something that will keep these papers together without damaging the photographs attached to them.
senses.exampleChinese: 我需要一个能把这些纸夹在一起、又不损伤所附照片的东西。

senses.english: to move or place a thing in a particular position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please put the chairs against the wall so that there is enough space for the group activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把椅子靠墙放，为小组活动留出足够空间。

collocations.english: put a book on the table

senses.english: express an idea in words
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you put the explanation more simply so that the younger visitors can understand what they need to do?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能把解释说简单些，让年幼游客明白要做什么吗？

senses.english: devote time, effort, or money to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers put a great deal of effort into restoring the garden before opening it to the public.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者投入大量精力修复花园，再向公众开放。

phrases.english: postpone or discourage
phrases.exampleEnglish: We decided to put off painting the benches until the weather improved enough for the wood to dry properly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们决定推迟粉刷长椅，等天气好转让木材充分干燥。

phrases.english: tolerate an unpleasant person or situation
phrases.exampleEnglish: The neighbours should not have to put up with loud music after the agreed finishing time of the event.
phrases.exampleChinese: 过了约定结束时间，邻居不该还得忍受吵闹音乐。

phrases.english: wear clothing, stage an event, or gain weight
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please put on a warm coat before leaving because the coastal wind feels much colder after sunset.
phrases.exampleChinese: 离开前请穿暖外套，因为日落后海风冷得多。

phrases.english: extinguish, publish, or inconvenience someone
phrases.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will put out the fire before leaving so that no one returns to an unsafe campsite.
phrases.exampleChinese: 志愿者离开前会把火熄灭，免得营地不安全。

senses.english: one more (thing); additional (thing)
senses.exampleEnglish: We need another volunteer to welcome visitors while the rest of the team prepares the main hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们还需要一名志愿者接待游客，同时其余队员准备大厅。

senses.english: one more or a different person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: One of the lamps had stopped working, so we borrowed another from the office across the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 一盏灯坏了，因此我们从大厅对面办公室借了另一盏。

senses.english: to begin to be; grow to be; develop into
senses.exampleEnglish: With regular practice, tasks that once seemed difficult can become much easier to complete without help.
senses.exampleChinese: 经常练习后，曾经看似困难的任务会变得更容易独立完成。

senses.english: to make someone want to know about something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide used old photographs to interest visitors in the everyday lives of the village's former residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游用老照片激发游客对村中昔日居民日常生活的兴趣。

senses.english: a desire to learn about or take part in something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her interest in local history began when she discovered photographs of the village inside an old cupboard.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在旧柜中发现村庄照片后，开始对地方历史感兴趣。

senses.english: something beneficial or advantageous to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee must consider the interests of residents as well as the businesses that depend on visiting tourists.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会须兼顾居民与依赖游客企业的利益。

senses.english: money charged for borrowing or paid on savings
senses.exampleEnglish: The leaflet explains how interest affects the total cost before giving a simple example of a monthly repayment.
senses.exampleChinese: 传单先解释利息如何影响总费用，再举月还款简单例子。

senses.chinese: 权益；股份；持有的利益关系
senses.english: a financial stake or involvement in something
senses.exampleEnglish: She has an interest in the family business, but she leaves everyday decisions to her brother who manages the shop.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在家族企业有权益，但日常决策交给管理商店的哥哥。

senses.english: an area of land that is controlled by a government
senses.exampleEnglish: Travelling through the country by train allowed us to see places that most tourists never visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 乘火车穿越这个国家，让我们看到了多数游客从不到访的地方。

senses.english: land outside towns and cities
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent the weekend in the country, walking between small villages and stopping at farms that sold fresh bread.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们周末在乡下度过，村间步行并在卖鲜面包农场停留。

senses.english: a style of popular music originating in rural America
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival included country alongside several other styles, giving visitors a chance to hear music they rarely encountered.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐节除其他风格也有乡村音乐，让游客听到少接触的音乐。

senses.english: having existed for a long time, not young or new
senses.exampleEnglish: The old bridge is no longer used by cars, but people still cross it on foot.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座老桥已不再通汽车，但人们仍会步行过桥。

senses.english: having lived or existed for a stated time
senses.exampleEnglish: The bridge is over two hundred years old, although several of its wooden sections were replaced much more recently.
senses.exampleChinese: 桥有两百多年，虽有几段木构很晚才更换。

senses.chinese: 以前的；原来的；熟识多年的
senses.english: former or known for a long time
senses.exampleEnglish: We visited our old school during the holiday and were surprised by how much the playground had changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 假期我们重访母校，惊讶操场变化很大。

senses.english: every one of two or more things
senses.exampleEnglish: Each participant received a different photograph and was asked to describe it without showing it to anyone.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位参与者收到一张不同的照片，要在不展示给别人的情况下描述它。

senses.english: every person or thing considered separately
senses.exampleEnglish: The participants received different objects, and each had to explain how their object might have been used in the past.
senses.exampleChinese: 参与者收到不同物件，每人须解释物件过去可能的用途。

senses.english: for every individual person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The notebooks cost two pounds each, which left enough money in the budget to buy some coloured pencils.
senses.exampleChinese: 笔记本每本两镑，预算还够买一些彩色铅笔。

senses.english: building where you learn in classes with a teacher
senses.exampleEnglish: The school opened its library on Saturdays so that local families could borrow books together.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校周六开放图书馆，方便当地家庭一起借书。

senses.english: a group of fish swimming together
senses.exampleEnglish: We watched a school of small fish move through the clear water while waiting beside the harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 在港边等候时，我们看一群小鱼游过清澈海水。

senses.english: happening near the end of a given time
senses.exampleEnglish: We enjoyed a late dinner after the concert, when most of the nearby restaurants were already closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐会后我们很晚才吃晚饭，当时附近多数餐馆已经关门。

senses.chinese: 迟到的；晚于预定时间的
senses.english: after the expected or usual time
senses.exampleEnglish: The late arrival of the materials meant that the volunteers could not finish the shelves before the weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 材料晚到，志愿者因此无法周末前做完架子。

senses.english: after an expected time or towards the end of a period
senses.exampleEnglish: We arrived late because the main road was closed, but the guide kindly repeated the instructions for us.
senses.exampleChinese: 主路封闭让我们迟到，但导游体贴地重讲说明。

senses.english: having died, used before someone's name or relationship
senses.exampleEnglish: The photographs belonged to her late grandfather, who had recorded changes in the village for more than fifty years.
senses.exampleChinese: 照片属于她已故祖父，他记录村庄变化五十多年。

senses.english: rising upward a great distance
senses.exampleEnglish: The high wall protected the garden from strong winds, allowing several delicate plants to grow successfully.
senses.exampleChinese: 高墙挡住了强风，让几种娇弱的植物得以顺利生长。

senses.english: large in amount, level, or importance
senses.exampleEnglish: The high cost of repairs forced the committee to choose which parts of the building needed attention first.
senses.exampleChinese: 高维修费迫使委员会选择先修哪些部分。

senses.english: at or to a great height or level
senses.exampleEnglish: The kite flew high above the field while the children tried to keep it away from the trees.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们设法避开树，风筝高飞在田野上。

senses.english: a highest level or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitor numbers reached a new high after the museum introduced practical workshops for families during the school holidays.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆假期开家庭实践工作坊后，游客人数创新高。

senses.english: not of the same kind; unlike other things
senses.exampleEnglish: We tried three different methods before finding one that was simple enough for everyone to use.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们尝试了三种不同方法，才找到一种人人都能使用的简单方法。

senses.english: away from; not on
senses.exampleEnglish: The cover was off the machine, so the technician could see which part needed to be replaced.
senses.exampleChinese: 机器外罩已经取下，技术员因此能看出哪个零件需要更换。

senses.english: away from a surface or near a coast
senses.exampleEnglish: We took the boxes off the table so that the instructor could spread out the diagrams before everyone arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把箱子从桌上拿走，让教练在大家来前铺开示意图。

senses.english: cancelled or not happening
senses.exampleEnglish: The afternoon walk is off because heavy rain has made the narrow path through the forest unsafe.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午徒步取消，因为大雨使穿林窄路不安全。

senses.english: no longer fresh or safe to eat
senses.exampleEnglish: The milk smelled off when we opened the fridge, so we used fresh milk from the shop instead.
senses.exampleChinese: 打开冰箱时牛奶闻着变质了，因此改用商店鲜奶。

senses.english: away from work or not operating
senses.exampleEnglish: She is off this afternoon, so another volunteer will answer questions about the workshop and take new bookings.
senses.exampleChinese: 她今天下午休息，另一志愿者会答工作坊问题并接预订。

senses.english: immediately after the previous one
senses.exampleEnglish: The next stage of the project involves testing the design with people who have never seen it before.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目的下一阶段，是让从没见过设计的人来测试它。

senses.english: immediately afterwards or on the following occasion
senses.exampleEnglish: We will discuss the budget next, once everyone has had enough time to examine the different designs on the table.
senses.exampleChinese: 人人看完桌上不同设计后，接下来讨论预算。

senses.english: a point that marks the limit of something; finish
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited until the end of the performance before asking the musicians about their unusual instruments.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们等到演出结束，才向音乐家询问那些不寻常的乐器。

senses.english: finish or bring something to a close
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide will end the tour beside the river so that visitors can continue exploring on their own.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游将在河边结束导览，让游客继续自行探索。

senses.english: to be alive
senses.exampleEnglish: Some trees can live for hundreds of years if they have enough space and suitable growing conditions.
senses.exampleChinese: 有足够空间和合适生长条件时，有些树能活数百年。

senses.english: have your home in a place
senses.exampleEnglish: They live near the station now, which makes visiting relatives in other towns much easier at weekends.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们现住车站附近，周末探望其他镇亲戚更方便。

senses.english: broadcast or performed as it happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The programme includes a live interview with the volunteers who restored the old boat beside the harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 节目包括对修复港边旧船志愿者的直播采访。

senses.english: alive, electrically charged, or still active
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not touch the live wire while the electrician checks which parts of the old lighting system need replacing.
senses.exampleChinese: 电工检查旧照明哪些部分须换时，不要触碰带电电线。

senses.english: as an event happens rather than from a recording
senses.exampleEnglish: The musicians will perform live in the garden, provided that the weather allows the stage to remain outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 若天气允许舞台留外面，音乐家将在花园现场演出。

phrases.english: meet a standard or expectation
phrases.exampleEnglish: The workshop needs to live up to its promises by giving every participant enough time to practise the new skills.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊须兑现承诺，让每个参与者有足够时间练新技能。

senses.english: for what reason or purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: Nobody understood why the lights kept going out until the technician checked the old wiring carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到技术员仔细检查了旧线路，大家才明白为什么灯总是熄灭。

senses.english: during the time that; at the same time
senses.exampleEnglish: I prepared the vegetables while my brother read the recipe and checked which ingredients we still needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我准备蔬菜时，弟弟读食谱并核对我们还缺哪些食材。

senses.english: contrasts two facts or situations
senses.exampleEnglish: While the larger room has more seats, the smaller one would make it easier for everyone to hear the instructor.
senses.exampleChinese: 大房间座位更多，而小房间更方便人人听清教练。

senses.english: a period of time
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited a while beside the entrance before a volunteer came to explain why the opening had been delayed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在入口等了一会，才有志愿者解释为何推迟开放。

phrases.english: pass time pleasantly
phrases.exampleEnglish: We can while away the afternoon in the café if the rain makes walking through the village unpleasant.
phrases.exampleChinese: 若雨让村中步行不舒适，我们可在咖啡馆悠闲过下午。

senses.english: all the humans, events, activities on the earth
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival brings together musicians from around the world, giving local audiences a chance to discover unfamiliar styles.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐节汇集世界各地的音乐家，让当地观众有机会接触陌生的风格。

senses.english: the planet Earth and all its places
senses.exampleEnglish: Photographs from around the world helped the children compare how people build homes in very different climates.
senses.exampleChinese: 世界各地照片帮助孩子比较不同气候中人们如何建房。

senses.chinese: 某一领域；某种生活圈子
senses.english: a particular area of activity or experience
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop introduced us to the world of furniture design, showing how practical problems can inspire simple ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊带我们进入家具设计领域，展示实际问题如何启发简单想法。

senses.english: period of seven days, starts on Sunday and end on Saturday
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent a week in the countryside, exploring small villages and learning how local farmers produced cheese.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在乡下待了一周，游览小村庄，了解当地农民如何制作奶酪。

senses.english: to do or perform a game or sport
senses.exampleEnglish: We usually play basketball after school, unless the sports hall is being used for another activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们通常放学后打篮球，除非体育馆被其他活动占用了。

senses.english: perform music or cause a recording to be heard
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will play several short pieces before the guide explains how the old instruments were made.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生先演奏几小段，再由导游讲古乐器如何制作。

senses.english: act as a character or perform a role
senses.exampleEnglish: She will play the village teacher in the performance, using stories collected from residents who attended the old school.
senses.exampleChinese: 她将在演出扮演乡村教师，用读过老学校的居民故事。

senses.english: a story written or performed for the theatre
senses.exampleEnglish: The play tells the story of a family whose small shop becomes the centre of village life.
senses.exampleChinese: 这出戏讲一家人的小店如何成为村中生活中心。

senses.english: activity done for enjoyment rather than work
senses.exampleEnglish: The garden includes a space for play so that younger children can enjoy themselves while their parents attend the talk.
senses.exampleChinese: 花园有游戏空间，让家长听讲时年幼孩子也能玩。

senses.english: used to express that something could happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The café might be closed when we arrive, so it would be sensible to bring some food.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到达时咖啡馆可能关门，所以带些食物比较稳妥。

senses.english: great strength or power
senses.exampleEnglish: We pulled with all our might, but the old cupboard would not move until someone removed its heavy drawers.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们使尽力气拉，直到有人拆掉重抽屉，旧柜才动。

senses.english: used to say that something is required or necessary
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors must keep to the marked paths because several areas contain plants that are easily damaged.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客必须沿标记小路行走，因为几个区域生长着易受损的植物。

senses.english: expresses a strong conclusion based on evidence
senses.exampleEnglish: The lights are still on upstairs, so someone must be checking the rooms before the building closes for the evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 楼上灯仍亮着，想必有人在晚上关门前检查房间。

senses.english: something essential or strongly recommended
senses.exampleEnglish: Comfortable shoes are a must for this walk because several parts of the route pass through rough woodland.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次徒步必备舒适鞋，因为几段穿过崎岖林地。

senses.english: place where a person or a family lives
senses.exampleEnglish: Their new home is close to the station, which makes visiting relatives much easier at weekends.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们的新家靠近车站，周末探望亲戚就方便多了。

senses.english: to or at the place where you live
senses.exampleEnglish: We arrived home later than planned because the road through the village had been closed for repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们回家比计划晚，因为穿村道路封闭维修。

senses.english: relating to your own country, team, or household
senses.exampleEnglish: The home team invited visiting players to join the village meal after the final match of the tournament.
senses.exampleChinese: 锦标赛决赛后，主队邀客队球员参加村宴。

senses.english: a place providing care or accommodation
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers collected photographs for a local care home so that residents could share memories of the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者为当地护理院收照片，让院中居民分享村庄记忆。

senses.english: not ever; not at any time
senses.exampleEnglish: I had never used this kind of camera before, so I read the instructions before taking photographs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我以前从没用过这种相机，所以拍照前先读了说明书。

senses.english: to make someone/something part of a group
senses.exampleEnglish: The ticket price will include a guided tour, although visitors must pay separately for the practical workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 票价将包含导览，但实践工作坊需要游客另外付费。

senses.english: route or direction that a river, etc., moves along
senses.exampleEnglish: The river changed its course after the storm, leaving part of the old walking path under water.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨后河流改道，旧步道的一部分被淹在水下。

senses.english: a series of lessons in a subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The course combines practical workshops with discussion, allowing beginners to develop skills before starting their own small projects.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程结合实践工作坊和讨论，让初学者先练技能再做小项目。

senses.english: the development or progress of events
senses.exampleEnglish: The course of the project changed after residents suggested turning the empty building into a shared workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民提议把空楼变共享工坊后，项目进程改变了。

senses.english: one part of a meal served separately
senses.exampleEnglish: The main course included vegetables grown in the community garden, which gave visitors something interesting to discuss over dinner.
senses.exampleChinese: 主菜用社区花园蔬菜，让游客晚饭时有话可聊。

phrases.english: certainly, or as expected
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can bring your own notebook, of course, although the organisers will provide paper for the practical activities.
phrases.exampleChinese: 你当然可自带笔记本，尽管组织者会给实践活动供纸。

phrases.english: during the progress of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We discovered several useful photographs in the course of sorting the boxes that residents had donated to the museum.
phrases.exampleChinese: 整理居民捐给博物馆的箱子过程中，我们发现几张有用照片。

senses.english: building in which a family, person lives
senses.exampleEnglish: The house at the end of the lane has a garden that overlooks the entire valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 小巷尽头那栋房子的花园能俯瞰整个山谷。

senses.english: provide space or accommodation for people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The old station now houses a small museum that explains how the railway changed life in the surrounding villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 老车站现容纳一座小博物馆，讲铁路如何改变周边村庄生活。

senses.english: a business or organisation of a particular kind
senses.exampleEnglish: A local publishing house agreed to print the guidebook after residents collected enough photographs to illustrate its main chapters.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民收够章节插图后，当地出版社同意印指南。

senses.english: account of something which gives the necessary facts and information
senses.exampleEnglish: The report explains why the bridge needs repairs and suggests how the work could be completed safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告解释了桥为何需要维修，并建议如何安全完成施工。

senses.english: give information about something or formally arrive for duty
senses.exampleEnglish: Please report any problems with the equipment before leaving so that the next group can use it safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开前请报告设备问题，让下一组安全使用。

senses.english: number of people or things gathered together
senses.exampleEnglish: Our group included several experienced walkers who helped the younger children cross the stream safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们组里有几位经验丰富的徒步者，帮助较小的孩子安全过溪。

senses.english: arrange people or things into categories or collections
senses.exampleEnglish: We should group the photographs by date so that visitors can follow the changes to the village more easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 应按日期归类照片，让游客易于了解村庄变化。

senses.english: example or instance of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The missing delivery was an unusual case, because every other parcel had arrived at the correct address.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次投递丢失很不寻常，因为其他每个包裹都送对了地址。

senses.english: a container protecting or carrying something
senses.exampleEnglish: The camera came in a strong case, which protected it when we carried the equipment along the rocky path.
senses.exampleChinese: 相机配结实箱子，我们沿石路搬设备时有保护。

senses.english: a matter examined by a court
senses.exampleEnglish: The case attracted attention because it concerned the future of a building that local residents wanted to preserve.
senses.exampleChinese: 案件引人关注，因为涉及当地居民想保存建筑的未来。

senses.english: a set of arguments supporting a position
senses.exampleEnglish: The residents made a strong case for repairing the library rather than replacing it with a completely new building.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民为修图书馆而非拆建新楼提出有力理由。

senses.english: a grammatical form showing a noun's role
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained how case changes the form of some pronouns before asking students to compare several examples.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先解释格如何改变某些代词形式，再让学生比较例句。

phrases.english: because something may happen
phrases.exampleEnglish: We carried extra water in case the small café beside the lake was closed when our group arrived.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们多带水，以防队伍到湖边时小咖啡馆关门。

phrases.english: regardless of other circumstances
phrases.exampleEnglish: The larger room is already booked, but in any case the smaller one would suit this workshop better.
phrases.exampleChinese: 大房间已订走，不过无论如何，小房间更适合本次工作坊。

senses.english: adult female human being
senses.exampleEnglish: The woman leading the workshop encouraged everyone to share a practical skill they had learned at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 主持工作坊的女士鼓励每个人分享一项在家学到的实用技能。

senses.english: located on every side, or along something
senses.exampleEnglish: There were benches all around the lake, so visitors could stop whenever they wanted to enjoy the view.
senses.exampleChinese: 湖的四周都有长椅，游客想欣赏景色时随时可以停下。

senses.english: approximately
senses.exampleEnglish: The journey takes around an hour, although it may be slower when the market attracts visitors from nearby towns.
senses.exampleChinese: 路程约一小时，不过集市吸引邻镇游客时可能更慢。

senses.english: surrounding or following the edge of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We walked around the lake before choosing a quiet place where the children could eat their packed lunches.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们绕湖步行，再找安静地方让孩子吃自带午餐。

senses.english: thing made of pages with writing on that you read
senses.exampleEnglish: The book contains detailed maps and useful advice for people who prefer travelling without a tour guide.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本书包含详细地图和实用建议，供喜欢不跟导游旅行的人使用。

senses.english: reserve a place, service, or ticket
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to book the room before Friday because another group has asked about using it the same evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 须周五前订房间，因为另一组问了同晚使用情况。

senses.english: records of money received and spent
senses.exampleEnglish: She checks the books every month to make sure the small shop has enough money to pay its suppliers.
senses.exampleChinese: 她每月查账，确保小店有钱付供应商。

senses.english: a group of people who are related through blood
senses.exampleEnglish: Her family moved to the town last summer, but they have already become involved in several local activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 她家去年夏天搬到镇上，但他们已经参与了好几项当地活动。

senses.english: a group sharing an origin or important features
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained that these plants belong to the same family despite looking very different during the winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释，这些植物冬天看着很不同，却属同科。

senses.english: to appear to be something
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions seem complicated at first, but the task becomes much simpler once you start practising.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明乍看很复杂，但一开始练习，任务就简单多了。

senses.english: to not stop someone from doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisers will let us use the hall if we promise to leave everything clean afterwards.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果我们保证事后打扫干净，组织者就会允许我们使用大厅。

senses.english: rent a property to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: They let the upstairs rooms to visitors during summer, using the income to repair the old family house.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们夏天把楼上房间租游客，用收入修祖宅。

phrases.english: disappoint someone or fail to support them
phrases.exampleEnglish: We do not want to let down the volunteers who have spent weeks preparing materials for the community event.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们不想让为社区活动准备材料数周的志愿者失望。

phrases.english: much less, especially after a negative statement
phrases.exampleEnglish: There was not enough space for our chairs, let alone the large table we had planned to bring.
phrases.exampleChinese: 空间连椅子都放不下，更不用说原想带来的大桌。

phrases.english: release your hold or stop holding onto something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Do not let go of the ladder until the person at the top has safely returned to the ground.
phrases.exampleChinese: 顶上的人安全回到地面前，不要松开梯子。

senses.english: one more time, once more
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to visit the exhibition again because there had been too many people on our first visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定再看一次展览，因为第一次去的时候人太多了。

senses.english: one type of thing
senses.exampleEnglish: This kind of material is useful for outdoor furniture because it does not easily absorb water.
senses.exampleChinese: 这种材料适合制作户外家具，因为它不容易吸水。

senses.english: caring and willing to help others
senses.exampleEnglish: The neighbours were kind enough to lend us their tools when they heard that our workshop had lost its supplies.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居听说工坊丢了物资，体贴地借出工具。

senses.english: to have and continue to hold something
senses.exampleEnglish: You can keep the guidebook after the tour, so there is no need to return it.
senses.exampleChinese: 导览结束后你可以保留指南，不必归还。

senses.english: cause something to remain in a state
senses.exampleEnglish: Please keep the doorway clear while the volunteers carry the large frames into the hall for the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者搬大框进展厅时，请保持门口畅通。

senses.english: continue or repeatedly do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The children kept asking questions because the old photographs showed everyday objects they had never seen before.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子不断提问，因为老照片有从没见过的日常物品。

senses.english: fulfil a promise or preserve a secret
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisers kept their promise to provide free materials, even though the cost had increased since the first workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管成本上涨，组织者仍履行免费供材料承诺。

senses.english: have and look after animals or a business
senses.exampleEnglish: The family keep a few chickens behind the house, which provides fresh eggs for the little village café.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人在屋后养几只鸡，为村中小咖啡馆供鲜蛋。

phrases.english: stay at the same pace or remain informed
phrases.exampleEnglish: The guide walked slowly so that the youngest visitors could keep up with the rest of the group.
phrases.exampleChinese: 导游走得慢，让最年幼游客跟得上全组。

phrases.english: continue communicating with someone
phrases.exampleEnglish: We promised to keep in touch after the workshop so that we could share ideas for future community projects.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊后我们答应保持联系，以分享后续社区项目想法。

senses.english: to be aware of sound; to perceive with the ear
senses.exampleEnglish: We could hear music coming from the square long before we saw the musicians standing there.
senses.exampleChinese: 还没看到站在广场上的音乐家，我们就远远听到了音乐。

senses.english: receive information about someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: We were pleased to hear that the old garden would reopen after volunteers finished repairing its damaged paths.
senses.exampleChinese: 听说志愿者修好受损小路后老花园重开，我们很开心。

senses.english: listen to evidence or arguments in an official setting
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee will hear the residents' concerns before deciding whether to approve the proposed changes to the village square.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会先听居民担忧，再决定是否批准广场改造。

phrases.english: receive communication from someone
phrases.exampleEnglish: We hope to hear from the organiser before Friday because we need to confirm transport for the whole group.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们希望周五前收到组织者消息，因为须确认全组交通。

senses.english: set of organized, planned ideas that work together
senses.exampleEnglish: The new booking system allows visitors to choose a time that suits them without calling the office.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的预订系统让游客无需打电话，就能选择适合自己的时间。

senses.chinese: 人体或生物中的器官系统
senses.english: a group of organs performing a shared function
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson explains how the digestive system works before asking students to compare the roles of its different parts.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程先讲消化系统运作，再让学生比较各部分作用。

senses.english: including each person or thing in a group
senses.exampleEnglish: Every visitor received a reusable cup so that the festival would produce less waste than before.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位游客都得到一个可重复使用的杯子，让音乐节比以前产生更少垃圾。

senses.english: express doubt about something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide encouraged us to question the information on old maps rather than accept every detail as accurate.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游鼓励我们质疑旧地图上的信息，而不是认定所有细节都准确。

senses.english: something asked to obtain information or test knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: Please write each question on a separate card so that the instructor can discuss similar problems together after the demonstration.
senses.exampleChinese: 请每个问题单写卡片，方便教练演示后归类讨论。

senses.english: a matter requiring discussion or a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: The question of parking remains unresolved, although the organisers have agreed on every other detail of the event.
senses.exampleChinese: 停车议题仍未解决，虽然其他活动细节已商定。

senses.english: ask someone questions, especially formally
senses.exampleEnglish: The historian questioned several older residents to discover how the village had changed before the railway arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 历史学家询问几位老人，了解铁路来前村庄的变化。

senses.english: at some point in the course of an event or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: We took notes during the demonstration because the instructor explained several techniques that were completely new to us.
senses.exampleChinese: 演示时我们做了笔记，因为教练讲了几种我们完全没接触过的技巧。

senses.english: at all times; in every situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The library always keeps a few tables free for visitors who have not been able to book.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆总会留几张空桌，给没能预约到的访客使用。

senses.english: large
senses.exampleEnglish: The new community hall is big enough to host concerts as well as regular classes and meetings.
senses.exampleChinese: 新社区大厅足够大，既能举办音乐会，也能开展常规课程和会议。

senses.english: important or serious in effect
senses.exampleEnglish: Moving the workshop was a big decision because several volunteers relied on being able to walk there from home.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬工作坊是重大决定，因为几位志愿者依赖从家步行到达。

senses.english: complete group of something (e.g., a chess set)
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought a complete set of tools so that everyone could take part in the repair workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们买了一套完整工具，让每个人都能参加维修工作坊。

senses.english: put something in a position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please set the boxes beside the wall so that the instructor has enough space to demonstrate the larger tools.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把箱子放墙边，让教练有空间演示大工具。

senses.english: decide or establish a time, rule, or target
senses.exampleEnglish: We should set a date for the next meeting before everyone leaves to travel home after the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊结束大家返家前，应定下次会议日期。

senses.english: adjust equipment to a required position or level
senses.exampleEnglish: Please set the timer for twenty minutes so that the paint can dry before we move the shelves.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把计时器设二十分钟，让漆干后再移架子。

senses.english: become firm or solid
senses.exampleEnglish: The glue needs time to set properly before the children can test how much weight their model bridge supports.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子测试模型桥承重前，胶水须有时间充分凝固。

senses.english: go below the horizon
senses.exampleEnglish: The sun began to set before we reached the village, so we took the shorter path beside the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 太阳开始落下时我们还没到村，因此走河边捷径。

senses.english: ready or firmly established
senses.exampleEnglish: We were all set to begin when the organiser discovered that several visitors had not received the final instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们准备就绪时，组织者发现几位游客未收到最终说明。

senses.english: the scenery or location prepared for a performance
senses.exampleEnglish: The students designed a simple set that could represent both the village shop and the family kitchen during the play.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生设计简单布景，在剧中兼作村店和家庭厨房。

phrases.english: establish or arrange something ready for use
phrases.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will set up the tables before visitors arrive so that the activity can begin without delay.
phrases.exampleChinese: 游客来前志愿者会布置桌子，让活动及时开始。

phrases.english: begin a journey or cause something to start
phrases.exampleEnglish: We should set off before the traffic becomes heavy if we want enough time to explore the garden.
phrases.exampleChinese: 想留足游园时间，应在交通繁忙前出发。

phrases.english: reserve something or temporarily ignore it
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please set aside enough paper for the afternoon group before using the remaining sheets to practise your designs.
phrases.exampleChinese: 请给下午小组留足纸，再用剩余纸练设计。

phrases.english: start a journey, explain clearly, or arrange visibly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The guide will set out the main safety rules before letting visitors explore the upper floors on their own.
phrases.exampleChinese: 导游会先讲清主要安全规则，再让游客自行探索楼上。

senses.english: little in size; not big
senses.exampleEnglish: The village has a small library, but its collection includes books in several different languages.
senses.exampleChinese: 村里有一座小图书馆，但馆藏包括好几种语言的书。

senses.english: to focus on learning something usually at school
senses.exampleEnglish: We study local plants during our weekly walks, recording any changes that we notice throughout the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在每周散步时研究当地植物，记录一年中注意到的各种变化。

senses.english: examine something carefully to understand it
senses.exampleEnglish: We studied the old photograph closely before deciding which parts of the building had changed since it was taken.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们仔细看老照片，再判断拍摄后建筑哪些部分改变。

senses.english: learning or research into a subject
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular study helped her understand the instructions without needing to translate every unfamiliar word before starting the activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 规律学习让她不必逐词翻译就能看懂说明开始活动。

senses.english: a detailed investigation or its report
senses.exampleEnglish: The study compared several ways of reducing waste at community events before recommending the most practical approach.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究比较社区活动减废方法，再推荐最实用方案。

senses.english: a room used for reading or working
senses.exampleEnglish: They turned the smallest bedroom into a study where the children could read quietly away from the television.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们把最小卧室改书房，让孩子远离电视安静阅读。

senses.english: to come after someone; be guided by someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Please follow the guide closely because the path becomes narrow where it passes through the rocky area.
senses.exampleChinese: 请紧跟导游，因为小路经过岩石区时会变得狭窄。

senses.english: act according to instructions, rules, or advice
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone must follow the safety instructions before using the tools, even if they have previous experience repairing furniture.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使有修家具经验，使用工具前人人也须遵守安全说明。

senses.english: understand a discussion, story, or explanation
senses.exampleEnglish: I could follow the first part of the explanation, but the final diagram was too complicated to understand immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 我听懂解释前半段，但最后示意图太复杂，不能立刻理解。

senses.english: happen afterwards or logically result from something
senses.exampleEnglish: A useful discussion followed the presentation, giving visitors a chance to compare the different designs on the table.
senses.exampleChinese: 讲解后进行了有用讨论，让游客比较桌上不同设计。

senses.english: pay attention to progress or news
senses.exampleEnglish: We follow the project's progress online because several friends are helping restore the old boat at the harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们网上关注项目进展，因为几位朋友帮修港边旧船。

senses.english: to do the first part of an action; to start
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop will begin once everyone has found a seat and checked that their materials are complete.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家找到座位并核对材料齐全后，工作坊就会开始。

senses.english: having a big effect on (person, the future)
senses.exampleEnglish: It is important to check the route beforehand, especially when some members of the group are inexperienced.
senses.exampleChinese: 提前核查路线很重要，尤其是当组里有人缺乏经验时。

senses.english: from the time in the past that
senses.exampleEnglish: We have used the same meeting room since the club opened, although the building has changed considerably.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部成立以来，我们一直用同一间会议室，尽管整栋楼变化很大。

senses.english: because or given that
senses.exampleEnglish: Since the room is already booked, we should ask the library whether another space is available for our group.
senses.exampleChinese: 既然房间已订走，我们应问图书馆是否有其他场地。

senses.english: from the time when something happened
