senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors can view the photographs online before deciding whether they want to join the guided tour of the old house.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客可先网上看照片，再决定是否参加老屋导览。

phrases.english: because of or considering something
phrases.exampleEnglish: In view of the bad weather forecast, the organisers moved the practical workshop into the hall beside the garden.
phrases.exampleChinese: 鉴于坏天气预报，组织者把实践工作坊移花园旁大厅。

senses.english: near close in the same place not far in a family or group
senses.exampleEnglish: We worked together to repair the old benches, sharing tools and learning useful skills from our neighbours.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们一起修理旧长椅，共享工具，也向邻居学习实用技能。

senses.english: to think carefully about something
senses.exampleEnglish: We should consider the needs of younger visitors before deciding how long the guided walk should last.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定导览步行持续多久之前，我们应该考虑年幼游客的需要。

senses.english: regard someone or something in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: Many residents consider the old garden essential because it provides a quiet place to meet away from busy roads.
senses.exampleChinese: 许多居民认为老花园必不可少，因为可远离闹路安静会面。

senses.english: to determine or set the cost of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The artist decided to price the smaller pictures reasonably so that more visitors could afford to buy them.
senses.exampleChinese: 画家决定给小幅画作定一个合理价格，让更多游客买得起。

collocations.chinese: 为产品制定有竞争力的价格

senses.english: the amount of money needed to buy something
senses.exampleEnglish: The price includes all materials, so visitors will not need to pay extra when the practical part begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 价格含全部材料，实践开始时游客无需额外付费。

senses.english: person's mother or father
senses.exampleEnglish: Every parent received a message explaining what their child should bring for the school trip next week.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位家长都收到了消息，说明孩子下周学校旅行应该带什么。

senses.chinese: 母公司；控制另一机构的公司
senses.english: a company controlling another company
senses.exampleEnglish: The parent company agreed to support the local project after staff explained how it would benefit families nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 员工解释有益附近家庭后，母公司同意支持本地项目。

senses.english: bring up and care for a child
senses.exampleEnglish: They try to parent calmly even when daily routines become difficult, making time to discuss problems with their children.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使日常安排困难，他们也尽量平和养育，留时和孩子讨论问题。

senses.english: difficult to bend, break or cut; solid
senses.exampleEnglish: The wood was too hard to cut with our small tools, so we borrowed a stronger saw.
senses.exampleChinese: 木头太硬，我们的小工具切不开，所以借了一把更结实的锯子。

senses.english: difficult to do or understand
senses.exampleEnglish: The task was hard at first because the instructions assumed we already knew how to use the unfamiliar tools.
senses.exampleChinese: 任务起初难，因为说明假定我们已会用陌生工具。

senses.english: with great effort, intensity, or force
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers worked hard all morning so that the garden would be ready before the first visitors arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者整个上午努力，让花园赶在首批游客来前备好。

senses.english: social event often with food, drinks, and dancing
senses.exampleEnglish: We organised a small party for the volunteers who had helped restore the community garden over the summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为整个夏天帮助修复社区花园的志愿者办了一场小聚会。

senses.english: an organisation seeking political power
senses.exampleEnglish: The party proposed a new transport plan, but residents asked how it would affect smaller villages outside the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 政党提出新交通计划，居民问对镇外小村影响。

senses.chinese: 一行人；团体；参与的一方
senses.english: a group travelling together or a participant in an agreement
senses.exampleEnglish: A party of visitors arrived early, so the guide began with the garden while the smaller rooms were being prepared.
senses.exampleChinese: 一队游客早到，导游先带花园，小房间同时准备。

senses.english: relating or restricted to a particular area, city, or town
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide recommended a local bakery where we could buy fresh bread before starting our morning walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游推荐了一家当地面包店，让我们能在晨间徒步前买新鲜面包。

senses.english: someone who lives in a particular area
senses.exampleEnglish: A local showed us a quieter route to the station that avoided the crowded market beside the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位当地人指条避开河边拥挤市场的安静车站路线。

senses.english: a nearby pub someone regularly visits
senses.exampleEnglish: They meet at their local after the evening class, where the owner keeps a table free for the group.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们晚课后在常去酒馆会面，店主为小组留桌。

senses.english: to direct how someone or something behaves or operates
senses.exampleEnglish: The new system lets staff control the temperature in each room without changing the settings elsewhere in the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 新系统让员工分别控制各房间温度，而不改变大楼其他地方的设置。

senses.english: having happened or been done before this time
senses.exampleEnglish: We had already booked our tickets when we discovered that the concert would take place outdoors.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现音乐会将在户外举行时，我们已经订好票了。

senses.english: a feeling of worry about someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents expressed concern about the extra traffic because children often cross the narrow road on their way to school.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民担心车流增加，因为孩子们上学时经常要穿过这条窄路。

senses.english: to be about or connected with someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The final section of the report concerns the training that new volunteers need before they begin working with visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告最后一部分涉及新志愿者接待游客前需要接受的培训。

senses.english: item that can be bought
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop lets customers test each product before buying, which makes choosing unfamiliar equipment much easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店允许顾客购买前试用每件产品，让挑选不熟悉的设备容易多了。

senses.english: to be unable to find something you once had
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep the tickets in the same pocket so that you do not lose them during the journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把票放在同一个口袋里，以免途中丢失。

senses.english: an account or description of how something happened
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide told a story about the family who had built the house and planted its unusual garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游讲述了建造这栋房子并种植独特花园的那家人的故事。

senses.english: only a little less than, nearly, not quite
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop was almost full when we arrived, but the organiser managed to find us two seats.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到达时工作坊几乎满员，但组织者还是给我们找到了两个座位。

senses.english: to do something without stopping, or after pausing
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to continue the discussion after lunch because several useful suggestions still needed to be considered.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定午饭后继续讨论，因为还有几个有用建议需要考虑。

senses.english: to be upright; not be sitting or lying down
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to stand near the back of the hall because all the seats were already taken.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不得不站在大厅后部附近，因为座位已经全满了。

senses.english: a firm opinion or position about an issue
senses.exampleEnglish: The council took a clear stand against the proposal after residents explained how it would affect the local park.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民说明提案对当地公园的影响后，市议会明确表态反对。

senses.english: to accept an unpleasant person, situation, or experience
senses.exampleEnglish: I cannot stand working in a noisy room, so I usually finish detailed reports before the other staff arrive.
senses.exampleChinese: 我受不了在吵闹的房间工作，所以通常在其他员工到来前完成细致的报告。

senses.english: complete or full; all of
senses.exampleEnglish: The whole village helped prepare the festival, from decorating the square to welcoming visitors at the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 整个村子都帮忙筹备节日，从装饰广场到在车站迎接游客。

senses.english: until now; up to the present
senses.exampleEnglish: We have not received the final timetable yet, so we cannot confirm when the workshop will finish.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们还没收到最终时间表，因此无法确认工作坊何时结束。

senses.english: speed or frequency of events over time
senses.exampleEnglish: The rate at which the plants grew surprised everyone, especially after several weeks of cold weather.
senses.exampleChinese: 植物生长的速度让大家吃惊，尤其是在经历几周寒冷天气之后。

senses.english: to judge the quality or value of someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors were asked to rate the exhibition after explaining which displays had helped them understand the history most clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客先说明哪些展品最有助于理解历史，再给展览评分。

senses.english: to feel that someone or something matters to you
senses.exampleEnglish: She cares about the team's progress and always makes time to help colleagues who are struggling with a task.
senses.exampleChinese: 她关心团队进展，总会抽时间帮助工作遇到困难的同事。

senses.english: the work of looking after someone or keeping something in good condition
senses.exampleEnglish: The young plants need regular care during their first winter because their roots have not yet developed fully.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些幼苗根系尚未发育完全，第一个冬天需要细心照料。

senses.english: to believe something is probably going to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: We expect the repairs to finish next month, provided that all the necessary materials arrive on time.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果所有必要材料按时到货，我们预计维修下个月结束。

senses.english: change brought about by a cause; result
senses.exampleEnglish: The new lighting had an immediate effect on the room, making it feel larger and more welcoming.
senses.exampleChinese: 新照明立刻改变了房间，让它显得更宽敞、更亲切。

senses.english: group or class of similar things or people
senses.exampleEnglish: This sort of map is particularly useful for walkers because it shows paths that ordinary road maps omit.
senses.exampleChinese: 这种地图对徒步者特别实用，因为它标出了普通公路地图省略的小路。

senses.english: to arrange things into groups according to their type
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to sort the donated clothes by size before deciding which shelves will make them easiest to find.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要先把捐赠衣物按尺码分类，再决定怎样上架最方便查找。

senses.english: at any time; at all times in the future
senses.exampleEnglish: Have you ever visited a place that looked completely different from the photographs you had seen beforehand?
senses.exampleChinese: 你是否到过一个地方，发现它和事先看到的照片完全不一样？

senses.english: thing of any kind; used to refer to a thing in questions
senses.exampleEnglish: Please ask if there is anything you do not understand before you begin using the new equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 开始使用新设备前，有任何不理解的地方请提问。

senses.english: to make something happen; create effect or result
senses.exampleEnglish: Leaving the windows open overnight could cause problems if the temperature falls below freezing before morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果天亮前气温降到冰点以下，整晚开窗可能会引发问题。

senses.english: something that makes an event or situation happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The engineers investigated the cause of the failure before recommending changes that would prevent the same problem from returning.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师先调查故障原因，再建议如何改进以防问题重现。

senses.english: dropping from a standing position to the ground
senses.exampleEnglish: A fall on the wet steps left him with a sore ankle, so we changed our walking plans.
senses.exampleChinese: 他在湿台阶上摔了一跤，脚踝疼痛，于是我们更改了徒步计划。

senses.english: a reduction in the amount, level, or value of something
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a sudden fall in visitor numbers after the main road closed for repairs during the summer holidays.
senses.exampleChinese: 暑假主路封闭维修后，游客数量突然下降。

senses.english: the season between summer and winter, especially in American English
senses.exampleEnglish: We plan to return in the fall when the trees change colour and the walking paths are less crowded.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们计划秋天再来，那时树叶变色，步道也不那么拥挤。

senses.english: to begin to be in a particular state
senses.exampleEnglish: The children fell asleep on the train after spending the whole afternoon exploring the museum with their grandparents.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们整个下午和祖父母参观博物馆后，在火车上睡着了。

senses.english: to give out (cards, etc.) to; distribute
senses.exampleEnglish: Please deal the cards evenly while I explain the rules to the people who have never played before.
senses.exampleChinese: 我向没玩过的人解释规则时，请把牌均匀发给大家。

senses.english: clear liquid that forms the seas, rivers, and rain
senses.exampleEnglish: We carried extra water because there were no shops or public taps along the route we had chosen.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们多带了水，因为所选路线沿途没有商店或公共水龙头。

senses.english: to pour water onto plants or the ground where they grow
senses.exampleEnglish: Please water the young trees before leaving because the forecast suggests that the next few days will be unusually hot.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开前请给小树浇水，因为预报说未来几天会异常炎热。

senses.english: to cause mail or package to go to another place
senses.exampleEnglish: Please send the updated timetable to everyone who registered, even if they have already received an earlier version.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把更新的时间表发给所有报名者，即使他们已收到早期版本。

senses.english: to let or permit someone do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The new arrangement will allow visitors to explore the gardens while the main building remains closed for repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的安排将允许游客在主楼因维修关闭期间游览花园。

senses.english: at a time not long from now
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum will reopen soon, although visitors will have to book tickets before entering the smaller galleries.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆很快重新开放，但游客进入较小展厅前需要订票。

senses.english: to look at carefully to work out what is happening
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped to watch the workers repair the roof, carefully replacing each damaged tile by hand.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们停下来观看工人修屋顶，他们正小心地手工替换每一块破瓦。

senses.english: a small clock worn on the wrist or carried in a pocket
senses.exampleEnglish: My watch stopped during the journey, so I asked another passenger whether we still had time to catch our connection.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅途中我的手表停了，所以我问另一位乘客是否还赶得上转车。

senses.english: the activity of looking carefully for danger or changes
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers kept watch by the river throughout the night because the water was rising after several days of rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 连日降雨后河水上涨，志愿者整晚在河边值守。

senses.english: the bottom or main supporting part of something, or a place for operations
senses.exampleEnglish: The group used the village hall as a base while volunteers visited families living in the surrounding countryside.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者探访周围乡村家庭时，团队把村礼堂用作基地。

senses.english: to use something as the main reason or starting point for a decision or idea
senses.exampleEnglish: We should base our decision on the latest results rather than assuming that last year's arrangement will work again.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应根据最新结果作决定，而不是假定去年的安排仍然适用。

senses.english: likely to happen or be true
senses.exampleEnglish: We will probably need a larger vehicle, since several people have offered to bring extra equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可能需要一辆更大的车，因为几个人主动提出带额外设备。

senses.english: to mention something that could be done; propose
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you suggest a quieter café where our group could discuss the project without disturbing other customers?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能推荐一家安静些的咖啡馆，让我们讨论项目又不打扰其他顾客吗？

senses.english: the time before now and the events that happened then
senses.exampleEnglish: Learning about the past helped the students understand why the town had developed around the old railway station.
senses.exampleChinese: 了解过去帮助学生理解这座城镇为何围绕旧火车站发展。

senses.english: beyond a particular place or later than a particular time
senses.exampleEnglish: Walk past the library and turn left at the bridge, where a volunteer will show you the meeting place.
senses.exampleChinese: 走过图书馆，在桥边左转，志愿者会在那里指给你集合地点。

senses.english: legal or official right to perform certain actions
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee has the power to approve small repairs, but larger changes need permission from the council.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会有权批准小修，但较大的改动需要市政会许可。

senses.english: energy used to operate machines, lights, and other equipment
senses.exampleEnglish: The storm cut off the power before the concert began, so the musicians moved their performance into the courtyard.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨在音乐会开始前导致停电，乐手便把演出移到庭院。

senses.english: the right or ability to control people, decisions, or events
senses.exampleEnglish: Local residents wanted more power over decisions that would change how the public land was used in future.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地居民希望对公共土地未来用途的决定有更多话语权。

senses.english: to supply the energy that makes a machine or system operate
senses.exampleEnglish: Small solar panels power the lights along the path, allowing visitors to return safely after the evening tour finishes.
senses.exampleChinese: 小型太阳能板为步道照明供电，方便游客晚间游览结束后安全返回。

senses.english: examination; questions to measure knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: The test includes practical tasks as well as written questions, allowing students to demonstrate several different skills.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项测验既有实践任务也有书面题，让学生展示几种不同技能。

senses.english: to go to a place for a time, usually for a reason
senses.exampleEnglish: We plan to visit the museum before lunch, when the galleries are usually less crowded and easier to explore.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们计划午饭前参观博物馆，那时展厅通常人少，更便于游览。

senses.english: an occasion when someone goes to see a person or place
senses.exampleEnglish: Our visit to the factory helped us understand how each team contributes to the quality of the finished product.
senses.exampleChinese: 参观工厂帮助我们理解各团队如何共同确保成品质量。

senses.english: the middle point or part of a place or object
senses.exampleEnglish: A large table stood in the center of the room so that everyone could see the model from different sides.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间中央放着一张大桌子，让大家从不同方向观察模型。

senses.english: to have something as the main subject or focus
senses.exampleEnglish: The discussion will center on practical solutions that small businesses can afford without reducing the quality of their services.
senses.exampleChinese: 讨论将集中于小企业负担得起且不降低服务质量的实用方案。

senses.english: to develop and become bigger or taller over time
senses.exampleEnglish: The plants grow more quickly near the window, where they receive natural light throughout the morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 植物在窗边长得更快，因为那里整个上午都有自然光。

senses.english: not anything, not a single thing
senses.exampleEnglish: There was nothing we could do until the replacement part arrived, so we started another task.
senses.exampleChinese: 替换零件到货前我们无事可做，所以开始了另一项任务。

senses.english: to come or go back to a place
senses.exampleEnglish: We will return to the village before sunset because the path becomes difficult to follow once the light begins to fade.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们将在日落前回村，因为天色渐暗后很难辨认小路。

senses.english: to give or put something back where it belongs
senses.exampleEnglish: Please return the borrowed tools before the workshop closes so that the next group can check everything before starting.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在工作坊关门前归还借来的工具，让下一组开始前能够检查。

senses.english: a result or benefit received, or an act of coming back
senses.exampleEnglish: The project offered little financial return at first, but it gradually created reliable work for people in the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目起初经济回报很少，但逐渐为村民创造了稳定工作。

senses.english: a female who has a child or children
senses.exampleEnglish: Her mother taught her to repair clothes, a skill that has saved the family money for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 她母亲教她修补衣服，这项技能多年来为家里省了钱。

senses.english: to move with your legs at a slowish pace
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to walk along the river instead of taking the bus, since the weather had improved.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气好转了，我们决定沿河步行，而不坐公交车。

senses.english: a journey made on foot, especially for pleasure
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide suggested a short walk along the coast before the group returned to the station for the evening train.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游建议先沿海岸短途散步，再回车站乘晚班火车。

senses.english: problem or reason for concern
senses.exampleEnglish: The missing keys were a serious matter because nobody else could open the cupboard containing the equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 钥匙丢失是个严重问题，因为没有其他人能打开存放设备的橱柜。

senses.english: the physical substance that things are made of
senses.exampleEnglish: The science teacher explained that matter can change from a solid into a liquid without becoming a different substance.
senses.exampleChinese: 科学老师解释，物质可以从固态变成液态，而不成为另一种物质。

senses.english: to be important or make a difference
senses.exampleEnglish: It does not matter which colour you choose, provided the letters remain clear enough for people to read easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要字迹足够清楚便于阅读，选哪种颜色都无关紧要。

senses.english: part of humans that allows us to think or feel
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop encouraged us to keep an open mind when listening to suggestions that challenged our usual approach.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊鼓励我们在听取挑战惯常方法的建议时保持开放心态。

senses.english: to feel annoyed or unhappy about something
senses.exampleEnglish: Would you mind closing the window before we start recording, because the traffic outside makes it difficult to hear clearly?
senses.exampleChinese: 开始录音前请关窗好吗？外面的车流声使人听不清楚。

senses.english: to pay attention to a danger or look after someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Mind the low doorway when you enter the cottage, and leave your bags beside the bench near the entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 进入小屋时当心低门框，把包放在入口附近的长凳旁。

senses.english: to say how much money something is worth
senses.exampleEnglish: An expert will value the old furniture before the family decides whether to keep it or sell it.
senses.exampleChinese: 家里决定保留还是出售旧家具前，将由专家先估价。

senses.english: to think that someone or something is important or useful
senses.exampleEnglish: We value your suggestions because you have direct experience of the problems that new members face during their first month.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们重视你的建议，因为你亲历过新成员首月遇到的问题。

senses.english: beliefs about what is right, important, or acceptable
senses.exampleEnglish: The discussion showed that both teams shared similar values even though they preferred different ways of organising the work.
senses.exampleChinese: 讨论表明，两队虽然喜欢不同工作安排，却有相似价值观。

senses.english: building of set of rooms used to do business or professional activities
senses.exampleEnglish: The office is closed on Fridays, but staff can still answer urgent questions through the shared email account.
senses.exampleChinese: 办公室周五关闭，但员工仍可通过共享邮箱答复紧急问题。

senses.english: the best result ever achieved in a particular activity
senses.exampleEnglish: She broke the school record after months of training, although her main goal had simply been to improve her own time.
senses.exampleChinese: 几个月训练后她打破校纪录，尽管最初只想提高个人成绩。

senses.english: to store information, sound, or pictures so they can be used later
senses.exampleEnglish: Please record the temperature every morning so that we can compare the results at the end of the experiment.
senses.exampleChinese: 请每天早晨记录温度，以便实验结束时比较结果。

senses.english: information or sound stored so it can be used later
senses.exampleEnglish: The library keeps a record of borrowed books so that staff can contact readers when another person needs the same title.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆保留借书记录，方便其他人需要同一本书时联系借阅者。

senses.english: to spend time visiting a place or someone's home
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to stay at a small guesthouse where the owners could recommend walks away from busy tourist areas.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定住一家小旅馆，店主能推荐远离繁忙景点的步行路线。

senses.english: a period of time spent in a place
senses.exampleEnglish: Our stay in the village lasted longer than expected because heavy snow closed the only road through the mountains.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于大雪封住唯一山路，我们在村里停留的时间超过了预期。

senses.english: to make someone do something they do not want or expect to do
senses.exampleEnglish: The sudden change in weather forced us to cancel the outdoor activities and move the workshop into the village hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气突变迫使我们取消户外活动，把工作坊移到村礼堂。

senses.english: physical strength or an influence that makes something happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The force of the wind pushed the gate open even though we had checked that the lock was firmly closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管我们确认锁已关紧，大风还是把门吹开了。

senses.english: to finish moving or to come to an end
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to stop beside the road because a fallen tree was blocking the narrow entrance to the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不得不停在路边，因为倒下的树挡住了通往村子的狭窄入口。

senses.english: a place where buses or other vehicles regularly pick up passengers
senses.exampleEnglish: The nearest bus stop is beside the library, where a clear map shows the routes to the surrounding villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 最近的公交站在图书馆旁，那里有标明周边村庄线路的清楚地图。

senses.english: more than two but not many
senses.exampleEnglish: Several visitors asked for a longer tour because they wanted more time to examine the unusual paintings.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位游客要求延长导览，因为他们想多花些时间仔细看那些独特画作。

senses.english: not heavy; weighing only a little
senses.exampleEnglish: The new tent is light enough to carry comfortably, even when we also need food and extra clothing.
senses.exampleChinese: 新帐篷很轻，即使还要带食物和备用衣物，背起来也很轻松。

senses.english: brightness that makes things visible, or a device that produces it
senses.exampleEnglish: Natural light filled the room after we removed the heavy curtains that had covered the windows for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们取下遮窗多年的厚窗帘后，自然光照亮了房间。

senses.english: pale in colour or having plenty of brightness
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose light colours for the walls because the small room had only one window facing the narrow courtyard.
senses.exampleChinese: 小房间只有一扇面向窄庭院的窗，所以我们选浅色刷墙。

senses.english: to make something start burning or provide brightness for a place
senses.exampleEnglish: They will light the candles after everyone arrives, creating a warm atmosphere without using the bright ceiling lamps.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家到齐后他们会点燃蜡烛，不开明亮顶灯也能营造温暖气氛。
usageNotes: lit 和 lighted 都可用作过去式、过去分词；a lighted candle 表示一支点着的蜡烛。

senses.english: to grow bigger, more complex, or more advanced
senses.exampleEnglish: Children can develop practical skills by helping with simple projects that require careful planning and teamwork.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们可以通过参与需要仔细规划和团队合作的简单项目，培养实用技能。

senses.english: to bring a previous image or idea to your mind
senses.exampleEnglish: Please remember where you put the spare key, because the office will be closed when we return.
senses.exampleChinese: 请记住备用钥匙放在哪里，因为我们回来时办公室会关门。

senses.english: small piece of something
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a bit of bread left after lunch, so we saved it to make soup later.
senses.exampleChinese: 午饭后剩了一点面包，所以我们留着稍后做汤。

senses.english: one part of something divided among people, or ownership in a company
senses.exampleEnglish: Each volunteer received an equal share of the money raised after the group had paid for materials and transport.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队支付材料和交通费用后，每位志愿者分到相同份额的筹款。

senses.english: actually existing or happening, not imagined
senses.exampleEnglish: Working on a real project helped the students understand problems that classroom exercises had never shown them.
senses.exampleChinese: 参与真实项目，帮助学生理解了课堂练习从未呈现的问题。

senses.english: solution to a problem or test question
senses.exampleEnglish: We compared our answers after the test and discovered that several questions could be understood in different ways.
senses.exampleChinese: 考试后我们对比答案，发现几道题可以有不同理解。

senses.english: to say or do something in response to a question or request
senses.exampleEnglish: Please answer the final question in your own words rather than copying a sentence directly from the article.
senses.exampleChinese: 请用自己的话回答最后一个问题，而不是直接照抄文章。

senses.english: to be in a resting position on a chair
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose to sit near the window so that we could watch the boats while waiting for lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选择坐在窗边，等午饭时可以看船。

senses.english: to calculate something or reach an opinion about it
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to figure out why the machine stops whenever two people try to use the controls at once.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要弄明白机器为何在两人同时操作时停机。

senses.english: a number representing an amount or measurement
senses.exampleEnglish: The latest sales figures suggest that more customers are choosing smaller products that are easier to repair at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 最新销售数据显示，更多顾客选择在家更易维修的小型产品。

senses.english: a person of a particular kind, or the shape of a body
senses.exampleEnglish: A familiar figure appeared at the entrance just as the guide was explaining why the building had been closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释大楼关闭原因时，一个熟悉的身影出现在入口。

senses.english: message you put in an envelope and send by post
senses.exampleEnglish: The letter explained why the delivery had been delayed and gave us a new date for its arrival.
senses.exampleChinese: 信中解释了投递为何延误，并告知新的到货日期。

senses.english: a written message sent to a person or organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: She wrote a letter to the council explaining why the old playground should remain open while repairs were being planned.
senses.exampleChinese: 她写信给市议会，解释旧游乐场为何应在规划维修期间继续开放。

senses.english: a symbol representing a speech sound in written language
senses.exampleEnglish: The first letter of each answer spells a hidden word, which gives students another reason to check their spelling carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个答案的首字母拼成隐藏单词，促使学生认真检查拼写。

senses.english: to make a choice about something or choose after thinking
senses.exampleEnglish: We should decide which tasks are most urgent before asking the volunteers to choose what they want to do.
senses.exampleChinese: 让志愿者选择想做的事之前，我们应该决定哪些任务最紧迫。

senses.english: words or signs used to communicate messages
senses.exampleEnglish: Learning another language can make travelling more enjoyable because everyday conversations become easier and more meaningful.
senses.exampleChinese: 学习另一种语言能让旅行更愉快，因为日常交谈会更轻松、更有意义。

senses.english: something discussed, studied, or taught
senses.exampleEnglish: The main subject of the meeting was how to make the library more useful for people who work during the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 会议主要议题是如何让图书馆更方便白天上班的人使用。

senses.english: to make someone experience something unpleasant or difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: The test would subject the material to extreme heat before researchers decided whether it was suitable for outdoor equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 测试将让材料承受高温，再由研究人员判断是否适合户外设备。

senses.english: a group of things or people with shared features or social position
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey compared travel habits across different social classes, while also considering age and the distance people travelled to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查比较不同社会阶层的出行习惯，也考虑年龄和通勤距离。

senses.english: a lesson, a course of lessons, or the students learning together
senses.exampleEnglish: Our evening class includes people from several professions who want to improve their English before applying for new jobs.
senses.exampleChinese: 夜校班里有多种职业的学员，想先提高英语再求职。

senses.english: act or process of growing bigger or more advanced
senses.exampleEnglish: The development of new paths has made the nature reserve easier to explore without damaging sensitive areas.
senses.exampleChinese: 新步道的建设，让人们更容易游览自然保护区，又不损害脆弱区域。

senses.english: small city
senses.exampleEnglish: The town becomes much busier during the summer, when visitors arrive to explore the nearby lakes.
senses.exampleChinese: 夏季游客来到附近湖区游览时，镇上会热闹得多。

senses.english: the part you get when one is divided into two; ½
senses.exampleEnglish: Half of the group stayed to finish the painting while the others went to collect more supplies.
senses.exampleChinese: 一半组员留下完成粉刷，其余人去领取更多用品。

senses.english: unit of time equal to 60 seconds
senses.exampleEnglish: Please wait a minute while I check whether the smaller meeting room is still available this afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 请稍等一分钟，我查一下那间小会议室今天下午是否还空着。

senses.english: extremely small in size or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The engineer noticed a minute crack in the pipe that could become dangerous if nobody repaired it before winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师发现管道上有细小裂缝，不在冬前修好可能变得危险。

senses.english: what people and animals eat to live
senses.exampleEnglish: We brought enough food for the journey because the small cafés along the route might be closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为旅程带足了食物，因为沿途小咖啡馆可能关门。

senses.english: to damage something or make an activity stop
senses.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to break the glass while removing the frame, because replacing it would delay the whole project.
senses.exampleChinese: 拆框时小心别打碎玻璃，否则更换玻璃会耽误整个项目。

senses.english: a short period when an activity stops so people can rest
senses.exampleEnglish: We took a short break after finishing the first section, then returned with fresh ideas for the more difficult questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 做完第一部分后我们稍作休息，再带着新想法处理难题。

senses.english: to fail to obey a law, rule, or agreement
senses.exampleEnglish: If we break the agreement without warning, other groups may be less willing to work with us in future.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果我们不先告知就违反协议，其他团体今后可能不愿合作。

senses.english: easy to understand, hear, or see
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were clear enough for new volunteers to complete the task without asking someone to explain each step.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明很清楚，新志愿者不必逐步询问也能完成任务。

senses.english: to remove unwanted things or allow something to move past
senses.exampleEnglish: Please clear the tables after lunch so that the next group has enough space to spread out their materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 午餐后请清理桌子，给下一组足够空间摊放材料。

senses.english: time that is to come after the present
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee will discuss the future of the building before deciding whether to repair or replace it.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会将讨论这栋楼的未来用途，再决定修缮还是重建。

senses.english: happening or existing at a later time
senses.exampleEnglish: The students recorded their methods carefully so that future researchers could understand how they had reached their conclusions.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生仔细记录方法，方便未来研究者理解他们如何得出结论。

senses.english: one of two (used when there is a choice of two)
senses.exampleEnglish: Either route will take us to the station, but the path beside the river is more pleasant.
senses.exampleChinese: 两条路线都通往车站，但河边那条小路更舒适。

senses.english: at a specified length of time in the past
senses.exampleEnglish: We visited the island several years ago, before the new bridge made travelling there much easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们几年前去过那座岛，那时新桥还没有让交通变得更方便。

senses.english: for each; during each
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop costs twenty pounds per person, including all the materials needed to complete a small project.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊每人收费二十英镑，包括完成一个小项目所需的全部材料。

senses.english: to be left behind, to continue to exist
senses.exampleEnglish: Several questions remain after the presentation, so the speaker has agreed to send us additional information.
senses.exampleChinese: 讲解后还有几个问题没解决，因此讲者答应发给我们补充信息。

senses.english: highest or upper part or point of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We climbed to the top of the tower, where the guide pointed out landmarks across the valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们爬到塔顶，导游在那里指出山谷各处的地标。

senses.english: in the center of some things; in relation to several things
senses.exampleEnglish: The old cottage was hidden among tall trees, which made it difficult to find from the road.
senses.exampleChinese: 老村舍藏在高树之间，从路上很难发现。

senses.english: to succeed in a game or contest
senses.exampleEnglish: The team hoped to win the final match, although their opponents had played extremely well throughout the season.
senses.exampleChinese: 球队希望赢得决赛，尽管对手整个赛季都表现极佳。

senses.english: a victory in a game, competition, or other contest
senses.exampleEnglish: The unexpected win gave the young team confidence before they faced a much more experienced opponent in the final.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场意外胜利给年轻队伍信心，决赛要面对经验更丰富的对手。

senses.english: the quality of things you can see (e.g., red, blue)
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a lighter color for the walls so that the narrow room would feel more spacious.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们给墙壁选了浅一些的颜色，让狭窄房间显得更宽敞。

senses.english: to give something a colour or influence how it is understood
senses.exampleEnglish: The children used natural materials to color the paper before explaining why they had chosen those particular shades.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们用天然材料给纸着色，再解释为何选这些色调。

senses.english: to have or be included as a part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The activity will involve some walking, so participants should wear comfortable shoes and bring water with them.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动会包含一些步行，因此参与者应穿舒适的鞋并带水。

senses.english: to come to or arrive at a goal or destination
senses.exampleEnglish: We should reach the village before sunset if we follow the shorter path through the woods.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果走穿过树林的较短路线，我们应该能在日落前到村里。

senses.chinese: 伸手可及的范围；影响范围
senses.english: the distance within which something can be touched, reached, or influenced
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep cleaning products out of children's reach, even when you are only leaving the room for a moment.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使只是离开片刻，也要把清洁剂放在孩子够不到的地方。

senses.english: involving activities among people especially free time activities
senses.exampleEnglish: The club organises social events as well as classes, giving newcomers a chance to make local friends.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部除了开课还组织社交活动，让新来的人有机会结识本地朋友。

senses.english: a length of time or a particular stage in history
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum focuses on a period when the town grew rapidly because the new railway brought more visitors and trade.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆着重展现新铁路带来游客和贸易、城镇迅速发展的时期。

senses.english: the punctuation mark used at the end of a complete sentence
senses.exampleEnglish: Remember to put a period after the final sentence before checking that every name in your report is spelled correctly.
senses.exampleChinese: 记得在最后一句后加句号，再核对报告中所有姓名拼写。

senses.english: the flow of blood that usually happens about once a month
senses.exampleEnglish: She kept a record of her period so that she could describe any changes clearly during her next appointment.
senses.exampleChinese: 她记录经期，以便下次就诊时清楚描述变化。

senses.english: from one side to the other of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The children watched the ferry travel across, then waited for it to return from the opposite bank.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们看着渡船驶到对岸，再等它从那边返回。

senses.english: a short written message or a brief record of information
senses.exampleEnglish: I left a note beside the kettle so that my flatmate would know why the water had been turned off.
senses.exampleChinese: 我在水壶旁留便条，让室友知道为何停水了。

senses.english: to notice something or write it down for later use
senses.exampleEnglish: Please note which parts of the instructions caused confusion so that we can improve them before the next workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 请记下说明中容易引起困惑的部分，方便下次工作坊前改进。

senses.english: a single musical sound or the symbol representing it
senses.exampleEnglish: The musician played the final note softly, allowing it to fade before the audience began to applaud the performance.
senses.exampleChinese: 乐手轻轻奏出最后一个音，余音消散后观众才开始鼓掌。

senses.english: a piece of paper money, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: I paid with a twenty-pound note because the small shop could not accept cards while its connection was down.
senses.exampleChinese: 小店断网无法刷卡，所以我用一张二十英镑纸币付款。

senses.english: study of past event
senses.exampleEnglish: Studying local history helped us understand why the village had grown around the river rather than the road.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究地方历史帮助我们理解，村庄为何沿河流而非道路发展。

senses.chinese: 历史记录；个人经历；病史
senses.english: a record of things that have happened to a person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The doctor asked about her medical history before explaining which questions would help them understand the recent changes.
senses.exampleChinese: 医生先询问病史，再说明哪些问题有助于了解近期变化。

senses.english: to make, cause, or bring into existence
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop encourages children to create useful objects from materials that would otherwise be thrown away.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊鼓励孩子们用原本会被丢弃的材料制作实用物品。

senses.english: to control a vehicle so that it moves somewhere
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to drive along the coast because the main road was closed for repairs that weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定沿海岸开车，因为那个周末主路封闭维修。

senses.english: a journey made in a car or similar vehicle
senses.exampleEnglish: The drive through the mountains took longer than expected because we stopped several times to admire the changing scenery.
senses.exampleChinese: 山间车程比预计长，因为我们数次停车欣赏变化的风景。

senses.english: at a point on a line
senses.exampleEnglish: Several benches stand along the river path, allowing walkers to stop and enjoy the view whenever they like.
senses.exampleChinese: 河边小路沿途有几张长椅，徒步者随时可以停下欣赏风景。

senses.english: group of things or people sharing common features
senses.exampleEnglish: This type of bicycle is suitable for city journeys, but it may be uncomfortable on rough country paths.
senses.exampleChinese: 这种自行车适合城市出行，但在崎岖乡间小路上可能不舒适。

senses.english: waves traveling in air or water that can be heard
senses.exampleEnglish: The sound of water running under the bridge became louder as we approached the narrow valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们走近狭窄山谷时，桥下流水声越来越大。

senses.english: to give a particular impression when heard or described
senses.exampleEnglish: Your plan sounds practical, but we should ask the volunteers whether they can manage the extra work before agreeing.
senses.exampleChinese: 你的计划听起来可行，但同意前应询问志愿者能否承担额外工作。

senses.english: sensible, reliable, or in good condition
senses.exampleEnglish: We need sound evidence before changing the design because a mistake at this stage could affect the whole project.
senses.exampleChinese: 改设计前我们需要可靠证据，因为此时出错会影响整个项目。

senses.english: part of the body that you see with
senses.exampleEnglish: The bright sunlight hurt my eyes, so I moved into the shade before looking at the map.
senses.exampleChinese: 强烈阳光刺得我眼睛难受，于是我先移到阴凉处再看地图。

senses.english: attention or the ability to notice and judge particular things
senses.exampleEnglish: She has an eye for detail and often notices small differences that the rest of the team has missed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她善于观察细节，常能发现团队其他人漏掉的小差异。

senses.english: sounds that are sung or played to give pleasure
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival introduced us to music from several countries that we had never heard performed live before.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐节让我们接触到几个国家的音乐，此前从没听过这些音乐的现场演出。

senses.english: activity with rules that people play to have fun
senses.exampleEnglish: The game encouraged children to share information because no single player had all the clues needed to finish.
senses.exampleChinese: 这款游戏鼓励孩子们共享信息，因为没有谁独自掌握完成游戏所需的全部线索。

senses.english: an organised contest played according to rules
senses.exampleEnglish: The final game lasted longer than expected because both teams defended carefully and refused to give up their advantage.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一场比赛比预计更久，两队都谨慎防守，不肯放弃优势。

senses.english: concerning government or public affairs
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains how political decisions changed the town's buildings and influenced the lives of ordinary residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览解释了政治决策如何改变镇上的建筑，并影响普通居民的生活。

senses.english: costing no money
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum offers free entry on Sundays, although visitors still need to book a time before arriving at the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆周日免费开放，但游客仍需事先预约入场时间。

senses.chinese: 空闲的；可用的；不受束缚的
senses.english: available to use or not restricted by obligations or control
senses.exampleEnglish: Are you free after lunch to help us move the tables before the next group arrives for its workshop?
senses.exampleChinese: 午饭后你有空帮我们搬桌子吗？下一组快来参加工作坊了。

senses.english: to release someone or make something available for another purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The new booking system will free staff from repetitive tasks so that they can spend more time helping visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 新预约系统将让员工摆脱重复工作，腾出更多时间帮助游客。

senses.english: to get something that someone has given or sent to you
senses.exampleEnglish: You should receive a confirmation message shortly after booking, so please check that your email address is correct.
senses.exampleChinese: 预订后不久你应该会收到确认消息，因此请检查邮箱地址是否正确。

senses.english: very short or brief period of time
senses.exampleEnglish: For a moment, everyone stopped talking and listened to the unusual sound coming from the old clock.
senses.exampleChinese: 有那么一瞬间，大家停止交谈，听着老钟发出的奇怪声音。

senses.english: giving something for money; the amount sold
senses.exampleEnglish: The sale of handmade postcards helped raise enough money to buy new materials for the children's workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 销售手工明信片筹到了足够资金，为儿童工作坊购买新材料。

senses.english: course of action proposed by an organization, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum changed its booking policy after visitors said they needed more flexibility when planning family trips.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客表示安排家庭出游需要更大灵活性后，博物馆更改了预订政策。

senses.english: extra; in addition
senses.exampleEnglish: We need further information about the route before deciding whether it is suitable for younger children.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定路线是否适合年幼孩子之前，我们需要更多相关信息。

senses.english: a person's physical self
senses.exampleEnglish: Stretching after a long journey can help your body feel more comfortable before you begin walking again.
senses.exampleChinese: 长途旅行后伸展一下身体，能让你再次步行前舒服一些。

senses.english: the main part of something or an organised group of people
senses.exampleEnglish: The body of the report explains the evidence, while the final section recommends changes that the committee could make.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告正文说明证据，最后一部分提出委员会可采用的改进建议。

senses.english: to need something, to make it necessary
senses.exampleEnglish: The practical workshop will require comfortable shoes because participants spend much of the session standing and moving around.
senses.exampleChinese: 实践工作坊要求穿舒适的鞋，因为参与者大部分时间要站着和走动。

senses.english: to spend time until an expected thing happens
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to wait inside the café until the guide arrived, rather than stand outside in the rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定在咖啡馆里等导游，而不站在外面淋雨。

senses.english: widespread, normal or usual
senses.exampleEnglish: The first part of the course provides general advice before later sessions focus on more specific practical tasks.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程第一部分提供一般性建议，后面的课再集中讲更具体的实践任务。

senses.english: to be seen, become visible; come into sight
senses.exampleEnglish: Small flowers begin to appear beside the path in spring, even before the trees have grown new leaves.
senses.exampleChinese: 春天树木尚未长出新叶时，小花就开始出现在路旁。

senses.english: facing or moving in the direction of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We walked toward the harbour, where the guide had arranged for us to visit a fishing boat.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们朝港口走去，导游已安排我们在那里参观一艘渔船。

senses.english: group of people working on a task together
senses.exampleEnglish: Our team includes people with different skills, which helps us solve practical problems from several different angles.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们团队成员各有所长，帮助我们从多个角度解决实际问题。

senses.english: not hard to do; not difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: The route looks easy on the map, but several steep sections can be tiring for inexperienced walkers.
senses.exampleChinese: 地图上这条路线看似容易，但几段陡坡会让经验不足的徒步者很累。

senses.english: single person, looked at separately from others
senses.exampleEnglish: Each individual in the group received a separate task before everyone came together to discuss their results.
senses.exampleChinese: 组里每个人先分到一项独立任务，然后大家聚在一起讨论结果。

senses.english: one person or thing considered separately from a group
senses.exampleEnglish: Each individual in the study received the same instructions, but their results varied according to how regularly they practised.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究中每个人收到相同说明，但结果随练习规律程度而异。

senses.english: containing or holding as much as possible
senses.exampleEnglish: The bus was already full when it reached our stop, so we had to wait for the next one.
senses.exampleChinese: 公交车到我们这站时已经满了，所以我们只能等下一班。

senses.english: containing as much as possible or having eaten enough
senses.exampleEnglish: The car park was already full when we arrived, so the guide directed us to another entrance beside the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到时停车场已满，导游便指引我们去车站旁另一个入口。

senses.english: color of the sky on a dark night
senses.exampleEnglish: The black cover protected the equipment from sunlight while making it harder to spot against the dark wall.
senses.exampleChinese: 黑色外罩让设备避开阳光，但靠着深色墙壁时也更难被发现。

senses.english: to perceive using sight, sound, taste touch or hearing
senses.exampleEnglish: She could sense a change in the atmosphere when the conversation moved from travel plans to family problems.
senses.exampleChinese: 话题从旅行计划转到家庭问题时，她能感觉到气氛变了。

senses.english: the meaning of something or its ability to be understood
senses.exampleEnglish: The final paragraph makes more sense once you understand why the writer changed her opinion halfway through the article.
senses.exampleChinese: 明白作者为何在文章中途改变看法后，末段就更容易理解。

senses.english: an ability to notice, feel, or judge something
senses.exampleEnglish: A strong sense of responsibility encouraged the volunteers to finish the repairs even after most visitors had gone home.
senses.exampleChinese: 强烈责任感促使志愿者在大部分游客回家后仍完成维修。

senses.english: to become aware of something without being told directly
senses.exampleEnglish: I could sense that something was wrong because everyone became quiet as soon as the manager entered the room.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理一进房间大家就安静下来，我察觉到有些不对劲。

senses.english: possibly, but not certainly; maybe
senses.exampleEnglish: Perhaps we should contact the museum before leaving, because its opening hours sometimes change during the holidays.
senses.exampleChinese: 也许出发前该联系博物馆，因为它的开放时间在假期有时会变。

senses.english: to put two things or numbers together (e.g., 2+2)
senses.exampleEnglish: Please add the dates to the shared calendar so that everyone knows when the equipment will be unavailable.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把日期加进共享日历，让大家知道设备何时不可使用。

senses.english: statement that says how things should be
senses.exampleEnglish: The main rule is that visitors must stay on the path to avoid damaging the plants nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 主要规定是游客必须沿步道行走，以免损伤附近植物。

senses.english: to govern a place or make an official decision
senses.exampleEnglish: The judge will rule on the disagreement after both sides have explained why they believe the original decision was unfair.
senses.exampleChinese: 双方解释为何认为原决定不公后，法官将对争议作出裁决。

senses.english: to travel through or near a place
senses.exampleEnglish: We will pass the old watermill on our way to the village, so there will be time for photographs.
senses.exampleChinese: 去村里的路上我们会经过老水磨坊，因此会有时间拍照。

senses.english: to move something to another person
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you pass the map to the person behind you so that everyone can check the route before we leave?
senses.exampleChinese: 请把地图递给后面的人，让大家出发前都能核对路线。

senses.english: to reach the standard needed in a test or examination
senses.exampleEnglish: She hopes to pass the examination this summer so that she can apply for a course starting in September.
senses.exampleChinese: 她希望今夏通过考试，以便申请九月开课的课程。

senses.english: to go by, especially when speaking about time
senses.exampleEnglish: Several weeks passed before we heard from the organisers, who had been waiting for permission to use the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 几周后我们才收到组织者消息，他们一直在等待场地使用许可。

senses.english: a document allowing entry or travel, or an act of sending a ball to another player
senses.exampleEnglish: Each volunteer received a pass that allowed them to enter through the staff entrance during the busy weekend event.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位志愿者都收到通行证，可在周末繁忙活动期间走员工入口。

senses.english: to manufacture something using machines
senses.exampleEnglish: The factory can produce smaller batches, which allows local businesses to order only what they really need.
senses.exampleChinese: 工厂能小批量生产，让当地企业只订购真正需要的数量。

senses.english: food grown on farms, especially fruit and vegetables
senses.exampleEnglish: The market sells local produce so that customers can buy fresh vegetables while supporting farms in the surrounding villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 市场销售本地农产品，让顾客购买新鲜蔬菜并支持周边农场。

senses.english: to exchange something for money
senses.exampleEnglish: The village shop plans to sell more locally made products so that visitors can support nearby businesses.
senses.exampleChinese: 村里的商店计划销售更多本地产品，让游客支持附近企业。

senses.english: small distance from one end to the other
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose the short route through the park because the children were tired after visiting the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 参观博物馆后孩子们累了，所以我们选了穿过公园的短路线。

senses.english: less than the amount needed or expected
senses.exampleEnglish: We were short of chairs when the extra guests arrived, so several volunteers brought some from the room next door.
senses.exampleChinese: 额外客人到来时椅子不够，几位志愿者从隔壁房间搬来一些。

senses.english: to have the same opinion as someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: We agree that the garden needs more seating, but we have different ideas about where to put it.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们都认为花园需要更多座位，但对摆放位置有不同想法。

senses.english: system or rules made by the government
senses.exampleEnglish: The new law requires businesses to provide clearer information about the cost of cancelling a booking.
senses.exampleChinese: 新法律要求企业更清楚地说明取消预订的费用。

senses.english: all of the things mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: Before leaving the workshop, please check that everything you borrowed has been returned to the correct cupboard.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开工作坊前，请检查借用的所有东西是否都已放回正确的橱柜。

senses.english: to carefully study to find and report new knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will research the history of the bridge before designing an exhibition about its importance to the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们将研究桥的历史，再设计展览说明它对村庄的重要性。

senses.english: to study a subject carefully to discover new information
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will research the history of their neighbourhood before deciding which local stories to include in the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生将先调查社区历史，再决定展览采用哪些当地故事。

senses.english: thing you put over something to close or hide it
senses.exampleEnglish: The waterproof cover kept our bags dry even when heavy rain started during the walk back.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使返程徒步时下起大雨，防水罩也让我们的包保持干燥。

senses.english: to put something over another thing to hide or protect it
senses.exampleEnglish: Cover the furniture before painting the ceiling so that drops of paint do not damage the fabric or wooden surfaces.
senses.exampleChinese: 刷天花板前盖好家具，防止油漆滴落损坏布料或木面。

senses.english: to deal with a subject or report what is happening
senses.exampleEnglish: The course will cover the main principles before introducing practical tasks that show how those ideas apply at work.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程先讲主要原理，再用实践任务展示这些想法如何用于工作。

senses.english: to provide enough money for a cost or expense
senses.exampleEnglish: The small grant should cover the cost of materials, but volunteers will still need to arrange their own transport.
senses.exampleChinese: 小额补助应够支付材料费，但志愿者仍需自行安排交通。

senses.english: something placed over another thing to protect or hide it
senses.exampleEnglish: The book's cover was damaged during the journey, although the pages inside remained clean enough for the children to read.
senses.exampleChinese: 书的封面在旅途中损坏，但内页仍干净，可供孩子阅读。

senses.english: pages of a book are made from this
senses.exampleEnglish: We used recycled paper for the invitations because the event was intended to encourage more environmentally responsible choices.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们用再生纸制作邀请函，因为活动旨在鼓励更环保的选择。

senses.english: a newspaper, an academic article, or a written examination
senses.exampleEnglish: Her paper describes how local schools changed their teaching methods after observing which activities helped pupils remember new vocabulary.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的论文介绍当地学校观察有效词汇记忆活动后如何调整教学。

senses.english: specific location where someone or something is
senses.exampleEnglish: The position of the table near the window made it easier to examine the small objects carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 桌子靠窗的位置让人更容易仔细观察小物件。

senses.english: a job or role in an organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: She applied for a position at the library because the role would combine her experience in education with her interest in history.
senses.exampleChinese: 她申请图书馆职位，因为这份工作结合了教育经验与历史兴趣。

senses.english: an opinion about a particular issue
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee explained its position clearly before asking residents to suggest changes that would address the remaining concerns.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会先清楚说明立场，再请居民提出解决余下顾虑的建议。

senses.english: to put someone or something in a particular place
senses.exampleEnglish: Position the camera near the window so that the person speaking receives enough natural light without facing the sun.
senses.exampleChinese: 把相机放窗边，让说话者有足够自然光又不必面对太阳。

senses.english: with a small distance between things
senses.exampleEnglish: The near end of the platform was crowded, but there was plenty of space beside the last carriage.
senses.exampleChinese: 站台近端很拥挤，但最后一节车厢旁有很多空间。

senses.english: a person; a man, woman or child
senses.exampleEnglish: Every human needs opportunities to rest, especially after spending a long time concentrating on difficult tasks.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个人都需要休息机会，尤其是在长时间专注于困难任务后。

senses.english: a machine for storing information and accessing the internet
senses.exampleEnglish: The computer stores our bookings in one place, making it easier to find details when visitors call.
senses.exampleChinese: 电脑集中储存预订记录，方便游客来电时查找详情。

senses.english: condition, location or position
senses.exampleEnglish: The situation improved once we agreed on a clear plan and made sure everyone understood their responsibilities.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们确定清晰计划，并确保每个人理解职责后，情况就改善了。

senses.english: employees of a company
senses.exampleEnglish: The staff helped us find a quieter room where we could discuss the project without disturbing other visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作人员帮我们找到一间安静些的房间，让我们讨论项目而不打扰其他访客。

senses.english: to provide the people needed to operate an organisation or service
senses.exampleEnglish: The information desk is staffed by volunteers who can explain the exhibits and help visitors plan a route around the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 咨询台由志愿者值守，他们解释展品并帮助游客规划参观路线。

senses.english: an action or task (e.g., sports, washing your clothes)
senses.exampleEnglish: The final activity involved building a small bridge from paper and testing how much weight it could support.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一项活动是用纸搭小桥，测试它能承受多大重量。

senses.english: movie
senses.exampleEnglish: The film follows a family who restore an old boat and use it to explore the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 这部电影讲述一家人修复旧船，再用它探索海岸的故事。

senses.english: to record moving images using a camera
senses.exampleEnglish: The students plan to film short interviews with residents before editing the material into a documentary about the changing neighbourhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生计划拍摄居民短访谈，再剪成讲述社区变化的纪录片。

senses.english: early part of the day before 12 noon
senses.exampleEnglish: We arrived early in the morning, when the market was opening and the streets were still quiet.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们一大早到达，那时集市正开市，街道仍很安静。

senses.english: situation where armies fight each other
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how the war affected ordinary families, using letters and photographs donated by local residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆用当地居民捐赠的信件和照片，说明战争如何影响普通家庭。

senses.english: arrangement with a bank to keep your money for you
senses.exampleEnglish: She opened a separate account to keep money for the project apart from her everyday spending.
senses.exampleChinese: 她另开了一个账户，把项目资金与日常开支分开。

senses.english: a spoken or written description of an event
senses.exampleEnglish: Her account of the journey helped us understand why the group had arrived much later than the organisers expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对旅程的叙述帮助我们理解团队为何远晚于组织者预期到达。

senses.english: to explain something or form a particular part of a total
senses.exampleEnglish: Local visitors account for most ticket sales, although the museum is becoming increasingly popular with people travelling from other regions.
senses.exampleChinese: 本地游客占售票大多数，尽管博物馆越来越受外地旅客欢迎。

senses.english: place which sells things
senses.exampleEnglish: The little shop beside the station sells maps and useful supplies for people exploring the nearby countryside.
senses.exampleChinese: 车站旁的小商店销售地图和实用补给，供游览附近乡村的人使用。

senses.english: to visit shops or websites to buy things
senses.exampleEnglish: We usually shop at the local market because we can compare prices and speak directly to the people who grow the food.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们常逛本地市场，因为可以比价并直接与种植者交流。

senses.english: important, serious, or large in scope
senses.exampleEnglish: The lack of public transport is a major problem for residents who do not have their own cars.
senses.exampleChinese: 对没有私家车的居民而言，公共交通不足是一个主要问题。

senses.english: important, large, or serious
senses.exampleEnglish: The new bridge will have a major effect on travel because drivers will no longer need to cross the town centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 新桥将对出行产生重大影响，司机不必再穿过市中心。

senses.english: the main subject studied for a university degree in the United States
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose history as her major after a school project showed her how ordinary letters can reveal important social changes.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校项目让她认识普通书信能反映社会变化，她便选历史为主修。

senses.english: person who is not known or named
senses.exampleEnglish: We need someone who can explain the instructions clearly and help visitors who have never used this equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要一位能讲清说明，并帮助首次使用设备的游客的人。

senses.english: in a higher place than something else
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice above explains which materials can be recycled and where visitors should put them after the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 上面的告示说明哪些材料可以回收，以及工作坊后应该放在哪里。

senses.english: to plan in a particular way to fulfill a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will design a small shelter that protects visitors from rain without blocking the view across the valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们将设计一个小棚，既能为游客挡雨，又不挡住山谷景色。

senses.english: something that happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The event brings together local artists who want to share their skills with people of different ages.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项活动汇集了想向不同年龄人群分享技能的当地艺术家。

senses.english: different from what is usual; better or greater than normal
senses.exampleEnglish: We prepared a special meal to thank the neighbours who had helped us during the long house repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们做了一顿特别的饭，感谢在漫长房屋维修期间帮忙的邻居。

senses.english: only at certain times; occasionally
senses.exampleEnglish: The road sometimes floods after heavy rain, so residents check the conditions before driving into the valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 大雨后道路有时会积水，因此居民开车进山谷前会查看路况。

senses.english: state of living you are in (e.g., good health)
senses.exampleEnglish: The bicycle was still in good condition, although its owner had used it almost every day for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 这辆自行车虽被车主多年来几乎天天使用，但状况仍然良好。

senses.english: the state something is in, or a particular health problem
senses.exampleEnglish: The old house was in poor condition when the family bought it, but careful repairs made it comfortable again.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人买下旧屋时房屋状况很差，但细致维修又让它舒适起来。

senses.english: something that must be true or done before something else can happen
senses.exampleEnglish: One condition of the agreement is that everyone completes safety training before using the equipment without a supervisor present.
senses.exampleChinese: 协议条件之一是人人须完成安全培训，才可在无监督时使用设备。

senses.english: to hold something and move it to another place
senses.exampleEnglish: Please carry the glass bottles separately so that they do not knock against the tools in your bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 请分开携带玻璃瓶，以免它们碰到包里的工具。

senses.english: to hold or move someone or something from one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: Two volunteers helped carry the heavy boxes upstairs while the rest of the group cleared a space beside the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 两名志愿者帮忙把重箱搬上楼，其他人在窗边清理空间。

senses.english: to include information or have goods available for sale
senses.exampleEnglish: The local paper will carry an article about the project once the students have finished interviewing the older residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生采访完年长居民后，当地报纸将刊登介绍该项目的文章。

senses.english: to select; decide between several possibilities
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors can choose a shorter walk if they want more time to explore the village before returning.
senses.exampleChinese: 想在返程前多花时间游村的游客，可以选择较短的步行路线。

senses.english: a male parent
senses.exampleEnglish: Her father showed her how to repair the chair, explaining why each piece had to fit tightly.
senses.exampleChinese: 她父亲教她修椅子，并解释每块零件为何都必须装得紧密。

senses.english: a choice you make about something after thinking about it
senses.exampleEnglish: We postponed the final decision until everyone had a chance to compare the costs of the different plans.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们推迟最终决定，让每个人都有机会比较不同方案的费用。

senses.english: raised flat surface
senses.exampleEnglish: We moved the table closer to the window so that everyone could see the photographs in natural light.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把桌子移近窗户，让大家都能在自然光下看照片。

senses.english: information arranged in rows and columns
senses.exampleEnglish: The table shows how travel times changed after the bridge opened, making it easier to compare the different routes.
senses.exampleChinese: 表格展示通桥后出行时间的变化，便于比较不同路线。

senses.english: being sure about something; without doubt
senses.exampleEnglish: We were certain that the route was correct because it matched the description in the guidebook exactly.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们确信路线没错，因为它与指南中的描述完全一致。

senses.english: having no doubt that something is true
senses.exampleEnglish: I am certain that we booked the larger room, although the confirmation email does not mention which floor it is on.
senses.exampleChinese: 我确定订了大房间，虽然确认邮件未写在哪一层。

senses.english: toward what is ahead or in front
senses.exampleEnglish: The queue moved forward slowly while staff checked tickets and answered questions about the evening's performance.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作人员检票并答复当晚演出相关问题时，队伍慢慢向前移动。

senses.english: most important; most often used
senses.exampleEnglish: The main entrance is closed for repairs, so visitors should follow the signs to the smaller side door.
senses.exampleChinese: 正门因维修关闭，因此游客应按指示前往较小的侧门。

senses.english: to stop living
senses.exampleEnglish: Several young plants began to die after being left in the hot greenhouse without enough water.
senses.exampleChinese: 几株幼苗因被留在炎热温室里又缺水，开始枯死。

senses.english: large brown animal with fur that lives in forests
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained how a bear searches for food before the colder months, when fewer plants are available.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释了熊如何在植物变少的寒冷月份前寻找食物。

senses.english: to accept or deal with something unpleasant
senses.exampleEnglish: She could not bear the thought of leaving the garden unfinished after the volunteers had worked so hard all summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者整个夏天辛勤工作后，她不忍让花园工程半途而废。

senses.english: to carry a responsibility, cost, name, or mark
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser agreed to bear the extra cost because the delay had been caused by a mistake in the original timetable.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者同意承担额外费用，因为延误由最初时刻表的错误引起。
usageNotes: 表示生育时过去分词常用 born，如 be born；表示承受、运送时用 borne。

senses.english: to use a knife or scissors to divide or open the surface
senses.exampleEnglish: Please cut the cardboard along the marked lines so that the pieces will fit together correctly later.
senses.exampleChinese: 请沿标记线裁纸板，让各部分稍后能正确拼合。

senses.english: to reduce the amount or level of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The company plans to cut energy use by improving insulation rather than asking staff to work in colder rooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司计划改善保温来降低能耗，而不是让员工在冷房间工作。

senses.english: a wound made by a sharp edge or a reduction in something
senses.exampleEnglish: A small cut on his finger made it difficult to hold the brush until a colleague brought him a plaster.
senses.exampleChinese: 手指上的小伤口让他难以握笔刷，直到同事拿来创可贴。

senses.english: to tell someone the appearance, sound or smell of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Can you describe the missing bag clearly enough for the station staff to recognise it if it appears?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能把丢失的包描述清楚，让车站工作人员发现时认出来吗？

senses.english: the same (male) person who did the action
senses.exampleEnglish: Although the instructions looked difficult, he managed to assemble the shelves himself without asking his neighbour for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然说明看起来很难，他还是没找邻居帮忙，自己装好了架子。

senses.english: present and able to be used
senses.exampleEnglish: Several places are still available on the afternoon tour, but you should book before leaving the information centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午的导览还剩几个名额，但你应在离开咨询中心前预订。

senses.english: more than usual; extremely
senses.exampleEnglish: The shaded path is especially pleasant during summer, when the open fields become too hot for comfortable walking.
senses.exampleChinese: 夏天开阔田野热得不适合舒适步行时，这条林荫小路尤其宜人。

senses.english: having big muscles; physically powerful
senses.exampleEnglish: The strong volunteer carried the heavy boxes upstairs while the rest of us prepared the tables.
senses.exampleChinese: 那位强壮的志愿者把重箱子搬上楼，其余人则准备桌子。

senses.english: to move from a lower position to a higher one
senses.exampleEnglish: We watched the sun rise above the hills while waiting for the first boat to leave the harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 等待第一班船驶离港口时，我们看着太阳从山上升起。

senses.english: an increase in amount, level, or value
senses.exampleEnglish: The sudden rise in demand surprised the organisers, who had expected only a few local families to attend the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 需求骤增让组织者意外，他们原以为只有几户本地家庭来参加。

senses.english: a female child
senses.exampleEnglish: The girl who designed the poster explained how she had chosen colours that people could recognise easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 设计海报的女孩解释了，她如何选出容易被人识别的颜色。

senses.english: possibly but not certainly; perhaps
senses.exampleEnglish: Maybe we should visit the smaller gallery first, since it usually closes earlier than the main museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 也许我们该先去较小的画廊，因为它通常比主博物馆关门早。

senses.english: group of people who share a common idea or area
senses.exampleEnglish: The local community worked together to restore the park, sharing tools and organising activities for younger residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地社区齐心修复公园，共享工具，也为年轻居民组织活动。

senses.english: otherwise; if you fail to...
senses.exampleEnglish: Finish labelling the boxes before the delivery arrives, or else we may send them to the wrong addresses.
senses.exampleChinese: 送货车来之前先贴好箱子标签，否则我们可能寄错地址。

senses.english: one specific (one)
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose this particular route because it passed the old watermill that my grandfather had described to us.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们特意选这条路线，因为它经过爷爷曾向我们描述的老水磨坊。

senses.english: character played by an actor
senses.exampleEnglish: She prepared carefully for her role as a village teacher in the play, studying photographs from the period.
senses.exampleChinese: 她为剧中乡村教师的角色认真准备，研究了那个年代的照片。

senses.english: to bring something close to another, to become one
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to join the two wooden sections securely before adding the wheels to the model cart.
senses.exampleChinese: 给小车模型装轮子前，我们需要先把两段木制部分牢固连接起来。

collocations.chinese: 把一部分接到另一部分

senses.english: to connect two or more things together
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to join the two sections carefully so that rain cannot enter the gap when the shelter is used outdoors.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们要仔细连接两部分，防止棚子在室外使用时雨水渗入。
